Especially with the countless baby supplies and meal prep routines that required more than three meals a day, the kitchen became a daily battleground. The daily grind of baby bottles, baby food bowls, and the family's dishes—the constant stream of them—was a constant source of frustration for my husband, exhausted from work, holding a bottle-cleaning brush, or for me, sighing at the pile of dishes after early-morning feedings. I felt a desperate conviction that I couldn't put off purchasing a dishwasher any longer. After comparing numerous options, we chose the LG Dios dishwasher for our childcare needs. The TrueSteam feature, in particular, gave us unwavering confidence in its hygienic capabilities, as high-temperature sterilization was a crucial requirement for us, as we handled bottles and baby food. Finally, we welcomed this savior into our kitchen, and over the past 100 days, our lives have been literally revolutionized. A dishwasher isn't just a machine that does the dishes; it's a magical tool that creates time for us. In the past, we would wash dishes three to four times a day, spending at least an hour to an hour and a half in the kitchen. Now, that precious time is ours, and the freed up time has had a decisive impact on improving the quality of our childcare. My husband, who used to have little time to play with the kids after work because of the dishes, can now load the dishwasher, clean up the kitchen in just 10 minutes, and then read or play with the kids right away. Thanks to this playtime with Dad, which begins right after mealtime, my kids are incredibly satisfied. Gone are the days of having to start over again after putting the kids to bed, staring at a pile of dishes. While the dishwasher quietly works, my husband and I enjoy a cup of warm tea, chatting, or simply relaxing. This precious recharge recharges us perfectly for the next day's childcare. The satisfaction of the LG dishwasher goes beyond simply avoiding dishes. The cleaning power and technology itself exceed expectations. From caked rice, dried baby food, and even greasy dishes for adults, this dishwasher perfectly meets the needs of parents who need to handle everything in one dishwasher. Powerful water streams from nozzles installed at the top and bottom thoroughly clean dishes. Thanks to the tornado cleaning blades and 10 different water streams, heavily soiled pans and pots can be placed at the bottom, while delicate dishes like glasses and baby bottles can be placed at the top for optimal cleaning results. I was even impressed to see that even a fried egg pan, which I was most worried about, was cleaned cleanly with just a light scrubbing and no pre-washing required. Parents use dishes of all sizes, from small spoons and chopsticks to baby food spoons of various shapes and sizes, and the LG dishwasher's three-tier tray system efficiently stores them all. The upper compartment holds small utensils like baby spoons and chopsticks, the middle compartment is height-adjustable for long bottles or deep soup bowls, and the lower compartment holds the most soiled plates and pots, allowing for a "batch-and-dump" method of handling all the dishes in one go. Drying, which is just as important as washing, is also satisfying. Plastic baby products, in particular, can leave water marks or smell if not properly dried. LG dishwashers automatically open the door after washing to vent the steam inside. This automatic door-opening drying process ensures dishes dry fluffy and without water marks. Natural air drying and evaporation also make them energy-efficient, making them safe for children's dishes. Ultimately, the dishwasher isn't just a simple appliance; it's become my husband's parenting companion and peace of mind. Minor friction over dishwashing order and quality, a common source of conflict in childcare households, can recur daily. The dishwasher instantly eliminated all of that friction. The simplicity of simply loading the dishes and pressing a button, without having to worry about who will do the dishes, has maximized the efficiency of household chores, creating an environment where both spouses can focus on childcare and relaxation. Unnecessary emotional drain in the kitchen has disappeared, allowing us to be more affectionate with each other. After the dishwasher was installed, the standards for kitchen cleanliness have risen, so we no longer procrastinate on washing dishes, and we've developed the habit of loading dishes directly after meals. As a result, the sink is always clean and clear, and using clean, sanitized dishes is also a huge help in protecting our children's health. The LG Dios dishwasher has been the best home appliance investment that has dramatically increased our family's satisfaction. Many people might hesitate because of the high price, but families with children have absolutely no reason to hesitate. For parents struggling with wrist and mental fatigue due to childcare, the LG Dios dishwasher is a revolution in their weary daily lives. We highly recommend purchasing it now and using the saved time to start a happier life with your child! This review is based on actual user experience, and satisfaction may vary depending on the user's environment and individual needs. #LGDishwasher #KitchenEssentials #DUE6BGL1E

시간은 육아의 질을 높이는 데 결정적인 영향을 미쳤습니다. 퇴근 후 설거지 때문에 아이와 놀아줄 시간이 부족했던 남편은 이제 식기세척기에 그릇을 넣고 10분 만에 주방을 정리한 후 곧바로 아이와 책을 읽거나 놀아줄 수 있게 되었습니다. 밥 먹고 바로 시작되는 아빠와의 놀이 시간 덕분에 아이의 만족도는 최고입니다. 또한 아이를 재우고 난 후, 쌓인 설거지 더미를 보며 다시 노동을 시작해야 했던 과거는 사라졌습니다. 식기세척기가 조용히 일하는 동안, 저희 부부는 오랜만에 따뜻한 차 한 잔을 마시며 대화를 나누거나 휴식을 취합니다. 이 소중한 재충전 시간은 다음 날 육아를 위한 에너지로 완벽하게 채워지고 있습니다.LG 식기세척기의 만족도는 단순히 설거지를 안 한다는 차원을 넘어섭니다. 세척력과 기술력 자체가 기대 이상입니다. 굳어버린 밥풀, 말라붙은 이유식, 그리고 기름기가 많은 어른들의 식기까지, 하나의 세척기로 모두 해결해야 하는 육아 가구의 요구를 완벽하게 충족시킵니다. 상단과 하단에 설치된 노즐에서 나오는 강력한 물살이 빈틈없이 식기를 닦아주며, 특히 토네이도 세척 날개와 10가지 다양한 물살 덕분에 오염도가 심한 팬이나 냄비는 하단에, 유리컵이나 젖병 등 섬세한 식기는 상단에 배치하여 최적의 세척 효과를 보았습니다. 가장 걱정했던 눌어붙은 계란 후라이 팬도 애벌 세척 없이 가볍게 음식물만 제거하고 넣었는데도 말끔하게 닦여 나오는 것을 보고 감탄을 금치 못했습니다. 육아 가구는 작은 수저부터 긴 젓가락, 다양한 모양의 이유식 스푼, 그리고 큼지막한 냄비까지 다양한 크기의 식기를 사용하는데, LG 식기세척기의 3단 트레이 시스템은 이 모든 것을 효율적으로 수납하게 해줍니다. 상단에는 이유식 스푼이나 젓가락 등 작은 도구를, 중단은 높이 조절이 가능해서 긴 젖병이나 깊은 국그릇을, 하단에는 가장 오염이 심한 접시와 냄비를 넣을 수 있어 하루 종일 나온 모든 식기를 한 번에 처리하는 '몰아서 설거지'가 가능해졌습니다. 세척만큼 중요한 건조 역시 만족스럽습니다. 특히 플라스틱 소재가 많은 육아 용품은 건조가 제대로 되지 않으면 물 자국이 남거나 냄새가 날 수 있는데, LG 식기세척기는 세척 후 내부의 습증기를 빼내기 위해 자동으로 문이 열립니다. 이 자동 문 열림 건조 덕분에 식기들이 물 자국 없이 보송보송하게 건조되며, 자연풍 건조와 증발을 활용하기 때문에 에너지 효율도 좋고 아이들 식기에 안심하고 사용할 수 있습니다.결론적으로 식기세척기는 단순히 가전제품이 아니라 저희 부부의 육아 동반자이자 평화 조약이 되었습니다. 육아 가구의 흔한 갈등 원인 중 하나인 설거지 순서와 퀄리티에 대한 사소한 마찰이 매일 반복될 수 있는데, 식기세척기는 이 모든 갈등의 불씨를 단번에 제거했습니다. 누가 설거지를 할지 고민할 필요 없이 그저 식기를 채워 넣고 버튼만 누르면 되는 단순함 덕분에 집안일 분담의 효율성이 극대화되어, 부부 모두가 육아와 휴식에 집중할 수 있는 환경을 만들었습니다. 주방에서의 불필요한 감정 소모가 사라지고 서로에게 더 다정한 말과 행동을 건넬 수 있는 여유가 생겼습니다. 식기세척기가 도입된 후에는 주방 청결에 대한 기준 자체가 높아져 설거지를 미루지 않게 되었고, 식사 후 바로 식기세척기에 그릇을 넣는 습관이 생겼습니다. 그 결과 싱크대는 늘 비어 있고 깨끗한 상태를 유지하게 되었으며, 늘 깨끗하게 살균된 식기를 사용하는 것은 아이의 건강을 지키는 데도 큰 도움이 됩니다. LG 디오스 식기세척기는 저희 가족의 삶의 만족도를 수직 상승시킨 최고의 가전 투자였습니다. 고가의 제품이라 망설이는 분들이 많으시겠지만, 아이가 있는 가정이라면 고민할 이유가 전혀 없습니다. 육아로 인해 손목 건강과 정신적 피로를 겪고 있는 부모님들께, LG 디오스 식기세척기는 지친 일상에 찾아온 혁명과도 같습니다. 지금 바로 구매하셔서 확보된 시간만큼 더 행복한 육아를 시작하시기를 강력하게 추천합니다! 본 리뷰는 실제 사용 경험을 바탕으로 작성되었으며, 사용 환경 및 개인에 따라 만족도는 다를 수 있습니다.#LG식기세척기 #주방필수템 #DUE6BGL1E

The LG Dios dishwasher has been the best home appliance investment that has dramatically increased our family's satisfaction. Sentence (English): I installed a Samsung Bespoke 14-seater dishwasher with my own money!
Comments (English): [ The oven was removed and installed cleanly, and the functionality was satisfactory, but it was disappointing that a refund was not applied. ] || ---------------- || I installed a Samsung Bespoke 14-seater dishwasher with my own money! My house has a built-in oven, so I had to remove it. The installation team neatly removed the oven and even picked it up right away, which was incredibly convenient. I was a little worried about having to figure out this separately, but it was all handled in one go, which greatly increased my satisfaction. The installation was completed on the exact date I requested. The remodeling team arrived at 11:00 AM to clear up the space, and the product installation team followed right away at 12:00 PM. The process was seamless and seamless, so there was no waiting, which was great. The installation was also very clean, and the technician explained the instructions step-by-step, so even I, a first-time dishwasher user, was able to understand it quickly. The product itself has a variety of cycles, making it fun to choose depending on the situation. I especially liked the fact that the model has a water filter, so it was washed with clean water. With a baby coming soon, I was hesitant to always wash and sterilize bottles in boiling water. But this product has a bottle sterilization cycle, which I think will be invaluable after the baby is born. The only regret is that this model doesn't have an energy efficiency rating at all, so it wasn't eligible for the 10% rebate. I assumed I was eligible for it, so I was a bit taken aback on the day of installation. The LG model was more expensive, so I hesitated until the end, but if I get the rebate on the LG model, the price will be similar. Still, I liked the design and features, so I decided to keep using it. Overall, the process from oven removal to installation was smooth, and I'm satisfied with the product. If you're thinking of buying it, just check for rebate availability, and if you're using the oven space like me, check to see if the installation team will also take care of removal and collection! I think I'll use it more often in the future, if only for washing baby bottles.

LG 모델이 가격이 더 비싸서 끝까지 고민했는데 LG모델 환급 받으면 가격이 비슷해지는 셈이더라고요.ㅠㅠ 그래도 디자인이나 기능은 마음에 들어서 그냥 잘 쓰기로 했어요.전체적으로는 오븐 철거부터 설치까지 과정이 매끄러웠고, 제품도 만족스러워요. 구매하실 분들은 환급 여부만 꼭 확인하시고, 저처럼 오븐 자리 활용하시는 분들은 설치팀에서 철거·수거까지 해주는지 체크해보시면 좋을 것 같아요! 저는 앞으로 젖병 세척 때문에라도 더 잘 사용할 것 같아요.

Sentence (English): We've had this Bosch 800 Series for a little while now and it's been great.
Comments (English): [ So quiet I forget it's running ] || ---------------- || We've had this Bosch 800 Series for a little while now and it's been great. The main thing that stands out is how quiet it is – I can run it after dinner and still have a conversation in the kitchen or watch TV in the next room without hearing it. Dishes, glasses, and pots all come out very clean, even on the normal cycle. I like the layout and the third rack for utensils and small items. It frees up a lot of space in the lower racks and makes loading more flexible. The controls are simple and the cycles are easy to understand. Drying performance has been solid, especially when we use the Auto or Heavy cycles and leave the door cracked after it finishes. If I had to nitpick, the cycles are a bit long compared to our old dishwasher, but the results and low noise level make it worth it. Overall, very happy with this purchase and would buy it again.

Sentence (English): Longer term review, have owned the product for about 4 years, worked well and cleaned as it should, all good - until last 6 months or so and since then it has started to trip out the electrical safety switch (RCD) whenever the weather is very humid.
Comments (English): Longer term review, have owned the product for about 4 years, worked well and cleaned as it should, all good - until last 6 months or so and since then it has started to trip out the electrical safety switch (RCD) whenever the weather is very humid. After a day or so and the weather gets less humid it will be OK. Yes, have tested it and it's the only appliance that is tripping the RCD (it's not combined earth leakage from this dishwasher and other things on the same circuit) as I've checked it by running it to a single (recently installed) powerpoint, which is on it's own new RCD circuit-breaker - and it alone trips it.I know many appliances have a small amount of earth leakage (e.g. 1-3 mA) and may get worse as they age and when humidity is high (dry = better insulation) (most RCDs trip when there is 30 mA or more electrical earth leakage). I also realize dishwashers are particularly prone to earth leakage as their heating element get older then micro-fractures may develop in the insulation which allow it to absorb moisture from air when humid and which can allow enough electrical current leakage to trip the RCD - but I've had a few dishwaters and a couple have done this, but this is by far the worst example I've come across.So, I guess I'm up to replacing the heating element (which is part of the inline pump), which will probably only last a couple of years before getting the same issue.

Yes, have tested it and it's the only appliance that is tripping the RCD (it's not combined earth leakage from this dishwasher and other things on the same circuit) as I've checked it by running it to a single (recently installed) powerpoint, which is on it's own new RCD circuit-breaker - and it alone trips it.I know many appliances have a small amount of earth leakage (e.g. 1-3 mA) and may get worse as they age and when humidity is high (dry = better insulation) (most RCDs trip when there is 30 mA or more electrical earth leakage). I also realize dishwashers are particularly prone to earth leakage as their heating element get older then micro-fractures may develop in the insulation which allow it to absorb moisture from air when humid and which can allow enough electrical current leakage to trip the RCD - but I've had a few dishwaters and a couple have done this, but this is by far the worst example I've come across.So, I guess I'm up to replacing the heating element (which is part of the inline pump), which will probably only last a couple of years before getting the same issue.

Sentence (English): This dishwasher comes with an 8 1/2 x 11 small print, folded user manual written in English, Spanish, and French, with instructions covering 1 and 1/2 pages.
Comments (English): [ Loading cereal and small sauce bowls is difficult ] || ---------------- || This dishwasher comes with an 8 1/2 x 11 small print, folded user manual written in English, Spanish, and French, with instructions covering 1 and 1/2 pages. I printed a comprehensive user manual from the GE website that was more than 28 pages long, as it included information in English, Spanish and French. I just printed the English part of the manual, which was 14 pages in length.It is difficult to load cereal and small sauce bowls despite pictures in the printed manual displaying several different methods to load the dishwasher with plates and bowls. I am still experimenting with the loading process. My older, ten year old GE dishwasher was much easier to load.The printed manual includes a section "Cycle Indicator Lights and Sounds" that states, "Clean - Displayed when a wash cycle is complete. The light stays ON as a reminder that the dishes are clean. Opening the door or pressing any key while the door is closed will turn the light off." This information is incorrect. An amber light is on during the wash cycle. The amber light was still on 30 minutes after the wash cycle was completed so I thought there was a malfunction, which a Google search verified. When I opened the door, the light did not turn off as stated in the manual.During a chat with a GE representative, I was told the Amber light stays on during the wash/dry boost cycle, and the light turns to white when the dishes are dry. Opening the door when the light is white turns off the light. I have only used the dishwasher for five days and so far it is working as it should.This three-star review is based solely on the included 1 1/2 page user manual, and the difficulty in loading dishes so they stay secure and don't bump against one another. How many buyers will think to download a comprehensive user manual from the GE website and just use the poorly written small print user manual that comes with dishwasher?

Sentence (English): This is the most well built and attractive dishwasher that I will more than likely be returning to Costco.
Comments (English): [ Beautiful machine. Horrible lower spray arm. ] || ---------------- || This is the most well built and attractive dishwasher that I will more than likely be returning to Costco. I have installed quite a few dishwashers in my life, and I must say the build quality is far superior to many of the others. It has a full frame under it with four metal height adjusters ensuring stability and allowing for a perfectly level installation. The racks are much sturdier than most and do not bow when fully loaded. The controls are easy to understand and use. It is very quiet and matches all of my other new GE Profile appliances perfectly.So now you ask; If this dishwasher is so great, why are you thinking of returning it? The problem is the lower spray arm. I installed my dishwasher two weeks ago, ran it once and it preformed well. When I attempted to run it a second time there was water pouring out the lower left corner of the door. I immediately stopped the machine and inspected the door gaskets, all were good. I started it again. and noticed each time the spray arm made a rotation past that corner, you could hear the water strike the corner and pour out onto the floor. I stopped the machine and inspected the lower spray arm, its end was badly melted from the prior drying cycle. I also immediately noticed the spray arm was missing the heat shields (small pieces of stainless steel used to keep the spray arm from melting on the heating element). I thought maybe they were inadvertently missed during the manufacturing process, so I contacted GE parts for a replacement. While on the phone with GE/Bodewell, I checked online and found the spray arm part number WD22X33499. I almost fell out of my chair when I saw the description stated "HEAT SHIELD NO LONGER REQUIRED". I expressed my concern with the GE/Bodewell call taker, and he advised maybe there was a problem with my initial spray arm and stated he would have a replacement shipped to me. A few days later I had the replacement part and quickly popped it onto my machine. I rotated it several times by hand and checked the clearance between it and the heating element with each revolution. I also rechecked to verify the machine was still level. All was good, so I ran the dishwasher again. The machine worked just as it was supposed to. After I emptied the dishwasher, I thought let me check the spray arm. Much to my disappointment, this one is also melted on the end.It is all so clear that this spray arm 100% needs heat shields on the ends to correct this situation. The ironic thing is prior versions of this same spray arm had factory installed heat shields. Apparently, those spray arms had a tendency to have the heat shields break off during the wash cycle, so they were redesigned to omit the heat shields.Both melted spray arms melted on the end with the drain hole. It is my opinion once the spray arm stops rotating, the water inside starts draining out the hole. In doing so this causes the spray arm to cant to one side and make contact with the heating element. Heat shields would prevent this.Over the next week or so I will be attempting to find a NOS GE spray arm with heat shields. If I can't find one, I might try one of the Chinese knock offs found on Amazon (reportedly most of them still have heat shields). If neither of these work, I will be removing this machine and returning it to Costco. Please help us out GE, put heat shields back on this spray arm. I love the fact my appliances all match, don't make me replace it with another brand.

I have installed quite a few dishwashers in my life, and I must say the build quality is far superior to many of the others. It has a full frame under it with four metal height adjusters ensuring stability and allowing for a perfectly level installation. The racks are much sturdier than most and do not bow when fully loaded. The controls are easy to understand and use. It is very quiet and matches all of my other new GE Profile appliances perfectly.So now you ask; If this dishwasher is so great, why are you thinking of returning it? The problem is the lower spray arm. I installed my dishwasher two weeks ago, ran it once and it preformed well. When I attempted to run it a second time there was water pouring out the lower left corner of the door. I immediately stopped the machine and inspected the door gaskets, all were good. I started it again. and noticed each time the spray arm made a rotation past that corner, you could hear the water strike the corner and pour out onto the floor. I stopped the machine and inspected the lower spray arm, its end was badly melted from the prior drying cycle. I also immediately noticed the spray arm was missing the heat shields (small pieces of stainless steel used to keep the spray arm from melting on the heating element). I thought maybe they were inadvertently missed during the manufacturing process, so I contacted GE parts for a replacement. While on the phone with GE/Bodewell, I checked online and found the spray arm part number WD22X33499. I almost fell out of my chair when I saw the description stated "HEAT SHIELD NO LONGER REQUIRED". I expressed my concern with the GE/Bodewell call taker, and he advised maybe there was a problem with my initial spray arm and stated he would have a replacement shipped to me. A few days later I had the replacement part and quickly popped it onto my machine. I rotated it several times by hand and checked the clearance between it and the heating element with each revolution. I also rechecked to verify the machine was still level. All was good, so I ran the dishwasher again. The machine worked just as it was supposed to. After I emptied the dishwasher, I thought let me check the spray arm. Much to my disappointment, this one is also melted on the end.It is all so clear that this spray arm 100% needs heat shields on the ends to correct this situation. The ironic thing is prior versions of this same spray arm had factory installed heat shields. Apparently, those spray arms had a tendency to have the heat shields break off during the wash cycle, so they were redesigned to omit the heat shields.Both melted spray arms melted on the end with the drain hole. It is my opinion once the spray arm stops rotating, the water inside starts draining out the hole. In doing so this causes the spray arm to cant to one side and make contact with the heating element. Heat shields would prevent this.Over the next week or so I will be attempting to find a NOS GE spray arm with heat shields. If I can't find one, I might try one of the Chinese knock offs found on Amazon (reportedly most of them still have heat shields). If neither of these work, I will be removing this machine and returning it to Costco. Please help us out GE, put heat shields back on this spray arm. I love the fact my appliances all match, don't make me replace it with another brand.

Sentence (English): Somehow, GE managed to engineer a dishwasher that can't get wet.
Comments (English): [ Don't get it wet! ] || ---------------- || Somehow, GE managed to engineer a dishwasher that can't get wet. Ironic, isn't it? Our dishwasher is right next to our kitchen sink, as I would expect is the case is most kitchens. Occasionally, when we use the sink to wash dishes, some water will pool on the countertop, and sometimes it will drip over the edge. If the water drips onto the dishwasher, it somehow always finds a way to sneak into the internal circuitry and short out the control panel, rendering the entire dishwasher inoperable. Same symptoms as many of the other reviews: it will randomly beep and lights will flash as if someone was physically pressing the buttons. But then, the buttons don't actually respond to physical touch. This has left us without a dishwasher for days and even weeks at a time while we wait for it to get repaired. Now it's out of warranty and we're stuck with a $1000 lemon that the manufacturer will never be held accountable for producing. I'll be opening a case with the FTC shortly.

Sentence (English): This dishwasher is great but after 2 months we are still learning to use it.
Comments (English): [ Great, But ] || ---------------- || This dishwasher is great but after 2 months we are still learning to use it. Bosch should provide more information on how to load it. Where should each kind of dish, glass, cup, pot be best located. I know that there are many sizes, but the engineers had something in mind when they designed the drawers and times. The user manual doesn't really give guidance. Equally sketchy is the how to use the different settings. Is "crystal dry" for crystal? I also have a suggestion about the capacitive sensing touch controls. They are too sensitive! (attested to by 2 other owners of this machine). Either allow for adjusting the sensitivity via the app or ask the user to press them for a longer time. Speaking of time, the 4 seconds between pressing start and closing the door is way too short. We are trying to start the washing cycle, not testing our reaction time. After all that, remember, I said the dishwasher itself is great.

Sentence (English): I recently bought a Samsung 6-person dishwasher, but I only looked it up on Naver and didn't know there was a model with a hot air drying function.
Comments (English): I recently bought a Samsung 6-person dishwasher, but I only looked it up on Naver and didn't know there was a model with a hot air drying function. It seems like it's only sold on Samsung.com. Anyway, I was curious about the hot air drying function, so I looked it up, and it seems to be a function that dries the water on the dishes with hot air. I think the strong drying function rinses them with 75 degree water and dries them. Before, even hand-washing dishes would sometimes leave them slippery, but now I can just put them in the dishwasher, which is convenient. Noise: It wasn't too noisy, which was nice. The integrated living room/kitchen design didn't cause any problems while watching TV or putting the baby to sleep. Storage/Space: It seats 14 people, so it holds a lot of dishes, and the internal basket is height-adjustable, so most pots and pans fit. At first, I had trouble figuring out how to load them, but after 23 cycles, I got the hang of it. Baby items: I was hesitant about buying a dishwasher because I have a lot of baby bottles and dishes, but I'm satisfied with the sterilization effect of the high-temperature cycle. Comments (English): [ Nice features and it cleans well ] || ---------------- || My Bosch started to leak after 8 years. Technician said it would be very costly to repair because of labor. This LG was on sale for 500$. It has 3 racks, which was a requirement. It also opens the door automatically to help drying. Like the Bosch, it relies on condensation to dry, so rinse agent is a must. The LG cleans well and it very quiet, as quiet as the Bosch it replaced. The door auto-open helps to dry a little better than the Bosch. Tops of mugs come out dry (before there was water collected). Some plastic items still have a few drops of water on them. If you are bothered that some items are not fully dry, look for another machine.The upper rack has two height positions. It's not as easy to switch as some other models, but from experience with the Bosch, the lower position works best for almost everything. The upper rack has one row of tines that can be folded. It also has two plastic trays that can hold a second level of coffee cups or can support wine glasses, which is I find very useful.The lower rack does not have folding tines. There are fewer tines than on some other models, but they are more spaced from each other. The result is that plates have room from each other, and they clean better. I have oversized plates that are 1.5" high (from the table), and in the Bosch I had to stack them in every other slot. In the LG, because the slots are wider, I can fit a plate in every slot without them touching each other. Also, because the tines are more spaced apart and upright, it's easier to fit a large stock pot between them, even without folding tines. Bottom line is that even though there are fewer tines, I can fit more items on the rack.A couple of negative points: there are not enough buttons for programs on the control panel. This is common to many new dishwashers. The dishwasher has WiFi and you must use the LG app to run extra programs, which is quite annoying.Another point is that the wheels of the racks are completely made of plastic, including the axle. There are no ball bearings. These wheels bear the weight of everything that you load on the racks. How long will this last? Time will tell.Finally, as someone else mentioned, the electrical and water inlet are located at the front of the machine, so require about 2 feet longer cables compared to machines that connect in the back. Measure carefully before you buy the water supply line and the electrical cable.

The LG cleans well and it very quiet, as quiet as the Bosch it replaced. The door auto-open helps to dry a little better than the Bosch. Tops of mugs come out dry (before there was water collected). Some plastic items still have a few drops of water on them. If you are bothered that some items are not fully dry, look for another machine.The upper rack has two height positions. It's not as easy to switch as some other models, but from experience with the Bosch, the lower position works best for almost everything. The upper rack has one row of tines that can be folded. It also has two plastic trays that can hold a second level of coffee cups or can support wine glasses, which is I find very useful.The lower rack does not have folding tines. There are fewer tines than on some other models, but they are more spaced from each other. The result is that plates have room from each other, and they clean better. I have oversized plates that are 1.5' high (from the table), and in the Bosch I had to stack them in every other slot. In the LG, because the slots are wider, I can fit a plate in every slot without them touching each other. Also, because the tines are more spaced apart and upright, it's easier to fit a large stock pot between them, even without folding tines. Bottom line is that even though there are fewer tines, I can fit more items on the rack.A couple of negative points: there are not enough buttons for programs on the control panel. This is common to many new dishwashers. The dishwasher has WiFi and you must use the LG app to run extra programs, which is quite annoying.Another point is that the wheels of the racks are completely made of plastic, including the axle. There are no ball bearings. These wheels bear the weight of everything that you load on the racks. How long will this last? Time will tell.Finally, as someone else mentioned, the electrical and water inlet are located at the front of the machine, so require about 2 feet longer cables compared to machines that connect in the back. Measure carefully before you buy the water supply line and the electrical cable.

Sentence (English): I live in an area of the US with very hard water, and wanted to upgrade my old dishwasher with one that included a built-in water softener.
Comments (English): [ Perfection ] || ---------------- || I live in an area of the US with very hard water, and wanted to upgrade my old dishwasher with one that included a built-in water softener. Of the very few brands available on the market with this feature, I chose the Bosch 800 Series dishwasher, and I could not be happier with my decision. The ADA model fits perfectly in my slightly-shorter-than-standard cut out space, and was easily installed by the professional who delivered the dishwasher. The owner's instruction manual tells you everything you need to know to run and program the cycles. This machine gets my dishes squeaky clean and has eliminated the dingy mineral build-up on my porcelain dishes. The folding tines provide accommodation for all manner of plates, bowls, and cookware. The upper rack, in addition to folding tines, includes two fold-down shelves that prevent plastic ware from flipping over, even without using the clever built-in clips to securely hold small items. The upper 3rd rack, amazingly, washes away even dried food particles such as egg yolk and melted cheese from knives and cooking utensils. The CrystalDry technology is a genius innovation that works so well everything comes out perfectly dry with no blast of steam when the door is opened at the end of the cycle. The app tells me that during the month of October, energy consumption was an average of 0.65 kWh per cycle, with an average water consumption of 2.6 gallons per cycle, making it extremely energy efficient and water-conscious. And it truly is so quiet that I cannot hear it running. It seems silly to gush over something so utilitarian as a dishwasher, but when a manufacturer actually "gets it right" on all levels, they deserve to be applauded.

That means that when you pull out the top rack to load items and then slide it back in, utensils tend to slide out of place forward or back with each movement of the sliding rack. KitchenAid needs to redesign the top rack and orient the loading scheme sideways so utensils are loaded perpendicular to the way the rack moves.

I'd give it 5 stars except for the top rack for utensils which isn't designed very well. First, it's often awkward to load the utensils to where they'll stay in place once the unit starts cleaning. Too many utensils move around and don't stay put during the cleaning cycle. Second, the top rack has its loading orientation front to back instead of sideways like many other dishwashers. That means that when you pull out the top rack to load items and then slide it back in, utensils tend to slide out of place forward or back with each movement of the sliding rack. If that top rack's loading scheme were oriented sideways like the top racks of other manufacturers (Bosch is one example), the utensils would stay in place a lot better when the sliding rack is pulled out or pushed in. KitchenAid needs to redesign the top rack and orient the loading scheme sideways so utensils are loaded perpendicular to the way the rack moves.

I can put silverware that hasn't been soaked, that has dried on food, and it comes out perfectly clean. Comments (English): TrueSteam (100°C high-temperature steam): Cleans dishes more thoroughly than by hand, with excellent sterilization effect. - Hot air drying system: Hygienic storage without moisture, enhanced drying performance compared to condensation drying. - AI washing course: Automatically detects the level of contamination and quantity of dishes and applies the optimal washing mode. - LG ThinQ app integration: Check the washing status and remote control via smartphone. - Generous capacity (for 14 people): Suitable for households of 3-5 people, capable of handling large dishes. - Premium design: The sophisticated appearance of the Objet Collection blends well with kitchen interiors. ---. Cons. - High price range: Around 1.5 million won, a burden compared to basic dishwashers. - Built-in installation required: Installation space is limited, requiring custom installation depending on the kitchen layout. - Consumables management: Filter and detergent management are essential, and long-term maintenance costs incur. ---. Overall evaluation. The LG Dios AI Objet Collection dishwasher is a premium product that combines hygiene, convenience, and design, delivering exceptional satisfaction, especially in high-humidity environments or households where hygiene is paramount. However, price and installation requirements are also important considerations. Ultimately, it's a great choice for households seeking to relieve the stress of dishwashing and enhance hygiene. Positive user reviews: - Cleaning power: Many users say it's much cleaner and more hygienic than hand washing thanks to its TrueSteam and hot air drying functions. - Convenience: The AI-customized wash cycle automatically detects the amount and level of dirt in the dishwasher, providing an optimized wash, resulting in high customer satisfaction. - Design: Many users rave about the Objet Collection's sleek design, which blends well with their kitchen interiors. - Capacity: Reviews say its large capacity, enough for 14 people, is particularly convenient for families. - Smart features: The LG ThinQ app integration allows for remote control and status monitoring, which is a welcome bonus. ---. Cons: - Price: At over 2 million won, some users find it a bit pricey for a high-end dishwasher. - Installation Restrictions: Some reviews indicate that this is a built-in model, making installation difficult depending on the kitchen layout. - Consumables Management: Some point out that the need for filter and detergent management increases long-term maintenance costs. ---. Overall Evaluation. Users rate the LG Dios AI Objet Collection Dishwasher as a product that, while a bit pricey, is well worth the price. It's particularly popular with households that prioritize hygiene, convenience, and design, highlighting its ability to simultaneously relieve dishwashing stress and upgrade the kitchen interior. LG Dios AI Objet Collection Dishwasher Review. Pros. - Powerful Cleaning Power: Thanks to TrueSteam (100°C high-temperature steam) and hot air drying, it's much cleaner and more hygienic than hand washing. Although the price is a bit high, it is a product with hygienic convenience.

Sentence (English): LG Dios AI Objet Collection Dishwasher Review.
Comments (English): TrueSteam (100°C high-temperature steam): Cleans dishes more thoroughly than by hand, with excellent sterilization effect. - Hot air drying system: Hygienic storage without moisture, enhanced drying performance compared to condensation drying. - AI washing course: Automatically detects the level of contamination and quantity of dishes and applies the optimal washing mode. - LG ThinQ app integration: Check the washing status and remote control via smartphone. - Generous capacity (for 14 people): Suitable for households of 3-5 people, capable of handling large dishes. - Premium design: The sophisticated appearance of the Objet Collection blends well with kitchen interiors. ---. Cons. - High price range: Around 1.5 million won, a burden compared to basic dishwashers. - Built-in installation required: Installation space is limited, requiring custom installation depending on the kitchen layout. - Consumables management: Filter and detergent management are essential, and long-term maintenance costs incur. ---. Overall evaluation. The LG Dios AI Objet Collection dishwasher is a premium product that combines hygiene, convenience, and design, delivering exceptional satisfaction, especially in high-humidity environments or households where hygiene is paramount. However, price and installation requirements are also important considerations. Ultimately, it's a great choice for households seeking to relieve the stress of dishwashing and enhance hygiene. Positive user reviews: - Cleaning power: Many users say it's much cleaner and more hygienic than hand washing thanks to its TrueSteam and hot air drying functions. - Convenience: The AI-customized wash cycle automatically detects the amount and level of dirt in the dishwasher, providing an optimized wash, resulting in high customer satisfaction. - Design: Many users rave about the Objet Collection's sleek design, which blends well with their kitchen interiors. - Capacity: Reviews say its large capacity, enough for 14 people, is particularly convenient for families. - Smart features: The LG ThinQ app integration allows for remote control and status monitoring, which is a welcome bonus. ---. Cons: - Price: At over 2 million won, some users find it a bit pricey for a high-end dishwasher. - Installation Restrictions: Some reviews indicate that this is a built-in model, making installation difficult depending on the kitchen layout. - Consumables Management: Some point out that the need for filter and detergent management increases long-term maintenance costs. ---. Overall Evaluation. Users rate the LG Dios AI Objet Collection Dishwasher as a product that, while a bit pricey, is well worth the price. It's particularly popular with households that prioritize hygiene, convenience, and design, highlighting its ability to simultaneously relieve dishwashing stress and upgrade the kitchen interior. Sentence (English): Many people say that the LG Dios AI Objet Collection dishwasher is a product that relieves the stress of washing dishes and even elevates the quality of the kitchen.
Comments (English): TrueSteam (100°C high-temperature steam): Cleans dishes more thoroughly than by hand, with excellent sterilization effect. - Hot air drying system: Hygienic storage without moisture, enhanced drying performance compared to condensation drying. - AI washing course: Automatically detects the level of contamination and quantity of dishes and applies the optimal washing mode. - LG ThinQ app integration: Check the washing status and remote control via smartphone. - Generous capacity (for 14 people): Suitable for households of 3-5 people, capable of handling large dishes. - Premium design: The sophisticated appearance of the Objet Collection blends well with kitchen interiors. ---. Cons. - High price range: Around 1.5 million won, a burden compared to basic dishwashers. - Built-in installation required: Installation space is limited, requiring custom installation depending on the kitchen layout. - Consumables management: Filter and detergent management are essential, and long-term maintenance costs incur. ---. Overall evaluation. The LG Dios AI Objet Collection dishwasher is a premium product that combines hygiene, convenience, and design, delivering exceptional satisfaction, especially in high-humidity environments or households where hygiene is paramount. However, price and installation requirements are also important considerations. Ultimately, it's a great choice for households seeking to relieve the stress of dishwashing and enhance hygiene. Positive user reviews: - Cleaning power: Many users say it's much cleaner and more hygienic than hand washing thanks to its TrueSteam and hot air drying functions. - Convenience: The AI-customized wash cycle automatically detects the amount and level of dirt in the dishwasher, providing an optimized wash, resulting in high customer satisfaction. - Design: Many users rave about the Objet Collection's sleek design, which blends well with their kitchen interiors. - Capacity: Reviews say its large capacity, enough for 14 people, is particularly convenient for families. - Smart features: The LG ThinQ app integration allows for remote control and status monitoring, which is a welcome bonus. ---. Cons: - Price: At over 2 million won, some users find it a bit pricey for a high-end dishwasher. - Installation Restrictions: Some reviews indicate that this is a built-in model, making installation difficult depending on the kitchen layout. - Consumables Management: Some point out that the need for filter and detergent management increases long-term maintenance costs. ---. Overall Evaluation. Users rate the LG Dios AI Objet Collection Dishwasher as a product that, while a bit pricey, is well worth the price. Comments (English): [ [3-month review] It seems better because it can accommodate 6 people. ] || ---------------- || I'm a Coupang regular, but I'm so lazy that I don't really write reviews, more like complaints, but I like it so much that I'm writing this (I've been using it for 3 months). ** Summary of advantages: No need to bend over, cleanly wash every meal, pots/frying pans without handles fit, 2-tier so it can be used in a small kitchen (actually, the installer said it wasn't possible because it was a bit narrow? I changed it after installing it and it's been working fine. As long as the holes are drilled, it can be installed and moved by an individual), It can accommodate 6 people, but it has an automatic door opening. ** Originally, I didn't know that the dishwasher was a new world because of the pre-wash part, but now I've experienced a new world because I wash it with water right after eating, run it, and do other things. 1. Reason for purchase: I couldn't remodel when I moved from my own house to a rental house, so I used a 12-person one, but I ended up using a 6-person one with some hesitation. 2. Advantages: 1) I haven't used the 6-person single-tier one yet, but it has 2 tiers so it's good for loading. You can put a computer and small plates on the 2nd tier, and large plates on the higher one. It's well designed so that you can put cutlery on the lower tier. 2) Special feature: This is the best, you don't have to bend over to put in the dishes. 3) Even though we're a family of 4, we don't eat out every meal, so sometimes I think the 12-person one is a little empty or I should gather them and pass them around at once. The fine oil film that forms when washing dishes by hand is completely gone, and the cups shine like new. 4. Drying Power: Almost perfect, except for the plastic. After four years of use, I've noticed that the drying power is better than I expected. Ceramics are completely fluffy. Frying pans dry well. Glass cups are almost free of water marks. Plastic sometimes has a few water droplets (a common problem with any dishwasher). However, leaving the door slightly open dries quickly, so it's not a major inconvenience. 5. Noise: I can run it at night. I usually run it at night after putting the kids to bed, and I haven't experienced any noise stress in four years. The sound of the water circulating is faint. It doesn't bother me when watching TV. It's also a plus that it's quiet enough to run at night. 6. Ease of Use: These are the advantages I've noticed from daily use. It holds 45 rice bowls, 23 soup bowls, plates, and children's plates. Cooking utensils fit easily as long as you adjust the angle. There's no water splashing or leaking (based on 4 years of use). The first installation wasn't difficult, and I did it myself when I switched to white. Connecting the hose took just a few minutes. Drainage is also easy. Cleaning is easy thanks to the small internal gaps. The filter only needs to be washed once or twice a week. There haven't been any major issues in 4 years. 8. Design: The BESPOKE is truly beautiful. The pink was beautiful, but the white is even prettier. It's simple yet luxurious, and it doesn't have the "space-hogging" feel typical of countertop models. It keeps the kitchen looking organized, and its sophisticated design adds a significant touch to the interior. It's a design that truly pleases every homemaker. In particular, my in-laws, who tried it, bought it right away and are still using it. I think this is the greatest testament to the actual user satisfaction. I liked the pink version, but the white one I bought this time is even neater and perfectly complements the kitchen atmosphere, making me so happy I bought it again. I confidently recommend it to anyone buying a dishwasher for the first time, those considering a small kitchen, or families with children. Having used it daily for four years, I can say that it's more than worth the money.

Comments (English): A true homemaker's review of the Samsung Electronics BESPOKE 6-person countertop dishwasher, purchased with her own money after using it for four years. They say only those who have actually used a dishwasher truly understand its convenience. I've been using this product for over four years, and while reorganizing my new home, I switched from the pink color to the white one. Interestingly, my mother-in-law, mother-in-law, and daughter-in-law all bought new ones after seeing me use it, and they're all very happy with it! Now, I'm buying new ones and recommending it to everyone I know. This dishwasher is truly trustworthy. 1. A homemaker's verdict after four years: I can't live without it. When I first bought it, I was skeptical, wondering, "How useful can this small countertop dishwasher be?" But now, I can honestly say it's the best purchase I've made, next to a washing machine vacuum cleaner. It saves me 30-40 minutes of daily hand-washing time, and best of all, it removes grease and grime much more thoroughly than washing dishes by hand. I have a child, so we handle a lot of dishes, and this product has significantly reduced wrist strain. 2. Why I switched from pink to white. The original pink was beautiful and luxurious, typical of BESPOKE, but the heater malfunctioned, so I moved. With my recent kitchen interior renovation, I thought white would be a better match, so I chose it without hesitation. White is much cleaner, makes the kitchen look more spacious, and goes well with any cabinet tone. Just a color change from the new model completely transformed the kitchen. I only changed the dishwasher, and it feels so much cleaner, so I'm 100% satisfied. 3. Cleaning power: This is the most satisfying aspect of my new dishwasher, which has remained constant for four years. Many dishwasher reviews worry that the small size might compromise cleaning power, but my four years of use have proven otherwise. It cleans dried rice, egg wash, and soup stains perfectly. A greasy frying pan is completely clean on high power. It washes children's plates, bottles, and straw cups without any detergent residue. Glass cups retain a clarity that you can never remove by hand. The glass cups, in particular, are incredibly crisp and clear, incomparable to hand washing. The fine oil film that forms when washing dishes by hand is completely gone, and the cups shine like new. 4. Drying Power: Almost perfect, except for the plastic. After four years of use, I've noticed that the drying power is better than I expected. Ceramics are completely fluffy. Frying pans dry well. Glass cups are almost free of water marks. Plastic sometimes has a few water droplets (a common problem with any dishwasher). However, leaving the door slightly open dries quickly, so it's not a major inconvenience. 5. Noise: I can run it at night. I usually run it at night after putting the kids to bed, and I haven't experienced any noise stress in four years. The sound of the water circulating is faint. It doesn't bother me when watching TV. It's also a plus that it's quiet enough to run at night. 6. Ease of Use: These are the advantages I've noticed from daily use. The simple button controls make it easy for my husband and in-laws to use. The spacious and versatile interior layout makes loading dishes a breeze. It holds 45 rice bowls, 23 soup bowls, plates, and children's plates. Cooking utensils fit easily as long as you adjust the angle. There's no water splashing or leaking (based on 4 years of use). The interior is intuitively wide, not square, making it easy to load. I found this to be much better than other brands. 7. Installation and maintenance are easy even for a single housewife. The first installation wasn't difficult, and I did it myself when I switched to white. Connecting the hose took just a few minutes. Drainage is also easy. Cleaning is easy thanks to the small internal gaps. The filter only needs to be washed once or twice a week. There haven't been any major issues in 4 years. 8. Design: The BESPOKE is truly beautiful. The pink was beautiful, but the white is even prettier. It's simple yet luxurious, and it doesn't have the "space-hogging" feel typical of countertop models. It keeps the kitchen looking organized, and its sophisticated design adds a significant touch to the interior. It's a design that truly pleases every homemaker. Overall Review: A housewife's verdict after using it for four years: a truly self-made purchase. I'm so satisfied that I'd buy it again. No problems in four years. Excellent cleaning power. Satisfactory drying performance. Good noise reduction. The design is top-notch. It improves the quality of life for housewives. In particular, my in-laws, who tried it, bought it right away and are still using it. I think this is the greatest testament to the actual user satisfaction. I liked the pink version, but the white one I bought this time is even neater and perfectly complements the kitchen atmosphere, making me so happy I bought it again. I confidently recommend it to anyone buying a dishwasher for the first time, those considering a small kitchen, or families with children. Having used it daily for four years, I can say that it's more than worth the money.

Sentence (English): A homemaker's verdict after four years: I can't live without it.
Comments (English): A true homemaker's review of the Samsung Electronics BESPOKE 6-person countertop dishwasher, purchased with her own money after using it for four years. They say only those who have actually used a dishwasher truly understand its convenience. I've been using this product for over four years, and while reorganizing my new home, I switched from the pink color to the white one. Interestingly, my mother-in-law, mother-in-law, and daughter-in-law all bought new ones after seeing me use it, and they're all very happy with it! Now, I'm buying new ones and recommending it to everyone I know. This dishwasher is truly trustworthy. 1. A homemaker's verdict after four years: I can't live without it. When I first bought it, I was skeptical, wondering, "How useful can this small countertop dishwasher be?" But now, I can honestly say it's the best purchase I've made, next to a washing machine vacuum cleaner. It saves me 30-40 minutes of daily hand-washing time, and best of all, it removes grease and grime much more thoroughly than washing dishes by hand. I have a child, so we handle a lot of dishes, and this product has significantly reduced wrist strain. 2. Why I switched from pink to white. The original pink was beautiful and luxurious, typical of BESPOKE, but the heater malfunctioned, so I moved. With my recent kitchen interior renovation, I thought white would be a better match, so I chose it without hesitation. White is much cleaner, makes the kitchen look more spacious, and goes well with any cabinet tone. Just a color change from the new model completely transformed the kitchen. I only changed the dishwasher, and it feels so much cleaner, so I'm 100% satisfied. 3. Cleaning power: This is the most satisfying aspect of my new dishwasher, which has remained constant for four years. Many dishwasher reviews worry that the small size might compromise cleaning power, but my four years of use have proven otherwise. It cleans dried rice, egg wash, and soup stains perfectly. A greasy frying pan is completely clean on high power. It washes children's plates, bottles, and straw cups without any detergent residue. Glass cups retain a clarity that you can never remove by hand. The glass cups, in particular, are incredibly crisp and clear, incomparable to hand washing. The fine oil film that forms when washing dishes by hand is completely gone, and the cups shine like new. 4. Drying Power: Almost perfect, except for the plastic. After four years of use, I've noticed that the drying power is better than I expected. Ceramics are completely fluffy. Frying pans dry well. Glass cups are almost free of water marks. Plastic sometimes has a few water droplets (a common problem with any dishwasher). However, leaving the door slightly open dries quickly, so it's not a major inconvenience. 5. Noise: I can run it at night. I usually run it at night after putting the kids to bed, and I haven't experienced any noise stress in four years. The sound of the water circulating is faint. It doesn't bother me when watching TV. It's also a plus that it's quiet enough to run at night. 6. Ease of Use: These are the advantages I've noticed from daily use. The simple button controls make it easy for my husband and in-laws to use. The spacious and versatile interior layout makes loading dishes a breeze. It holds 45 rice bowls, 23 soup bowls, plates, and children's plates. Cooking utensils fit easily as long as you adjust the angle. There's no water splashing or leaking (based on 4 years of use). The interior is intuitively wide, not square, making it easy to load. I found this to be much better than other brands. 7. Installation and maintenance are easy even for a single housewife. The first installation wasn't difficult, and I did it myself when I switched to white. Connecting the hose took just a few minutes. Drainage is also easy. Cleaning is easy thanks to the small internal gaps. The filter only needs to be washed once or twice a week. There haven't been any major issues in 4 years. 8. Design: The BESPOKE is truly beautiful. The pink was beautiful, but the white is even prettier. It's simple yet luxurious, and it doesn't have the "space-hogging" feel typical of countertop models. It keeps the kitchen looking organized, and its sophisticated design adds a significant touch to the interior. It's a design that truly pleases every homemaker. Overall Review: A housewife's verdict after using it for four years: a truly self-made purchase. I'm so satisfied that I'd buy it again. No problems in four years. Excellent cleaning power. Satisfactory drying performance. Good noise reduction. The design is top-notch. It improves the quality of life for housewives. In particular, my in-laws, who tried it, bought it right away and are still using it. I think this is the greatest testament to the actual user satisfaction. I liked the pink version, but the white one I bought this time is even neater and perfectly complements the kitchen atmosphere, making me so happy I bought it again. I confidently recommend it to anyone buying a dishwasher for the first time, those considering a small kitchen, or families with children. Having used it daily for four years, I can say that it's more than worth the money.

I only changed the dishwasher, and it feels so much cleaner, so I'm 100% satisfied. 3. 고급스러웠는데, 히터기능이 고장나서 이사도했고 이번에 주방 인테리어를 바꾸면서 화이트가 더 잘 어울릴 것 같아 고민 없이 화이트로 선택했어요.•화이트는 훨씬 더 깔끔하고•주방이 넓어 보이고•어떤 톤의 상부장/하부장에도 잘 어울리고새 제품이랑 색감만 바뀌었을 뿐인데 주방 분위기가 확 달라졌어요.식기세척기 하나만 바꿨는데 깔끔함이 훨씬 살아나는 느낌이라 만족도 수월하게 들어감✔ 외부 물 튀는 일 없고 물 새는 일 전혀 없음 (4년 사용 기준)특히 내부가 ㄹ자 구조가 아니라 직관적으로 넓게 뻗은 구조라서 넣기가 쉬워요.이 부분은 다른 브랜드보다 훨씬 좋다고 느꼈습니다.⸻ 7. 설치, 관리 – 주부 혼자서도 가능처음 설치할 때도 어렵지 않았고, 이번에 화이트로 바꿀 때도 제가 혼자 설치했어요.•호스 연결 → 몇 분이면 끝•배수도 편함•청소도 내부 틈이 적어서 관리 쉬움•필터는 주 1~2회만 씻어주면 OK4년 동안 특별한 고장 1도 없었습니다.⸻ 8. 디자인 – BESPOKE 진짜 예쁨핑크도 예뻤지만 화이트는 정말 더 예뻐요.심플하면서 고급스럽고, 특히 카운터탑 타입 특유의 ‘공간 차지하는 느낌’이 거의 없습니다.주방이 정돈돼 보이고, 세련된 분위기라 인테리어 효과도 커요.주부의 눈을 만족시키는 디자인이라는 게 가장 정확해요.⸻ 총평: 4년 써본 주부의 진짜 내돈내산 결론✔ 다시 사라면 또 살 만큼 만족도 높음✔ 4년 동안 고장 없음✔ 세척력 → 뛰어남✔ 건조력 → 만족✔ 소음 → 양호✔ 디자인 → 최고✔ 주부 삶의 질이 올라감특히“이 제품 써본 시댁 아가씨도 바로 사서 지금도 잘 쓰고 있다”는 부분이 실사용자 만족도를 말해주는 가장 큰 증거라고 생각해요.핑크 버전도 좋았지만, 이번에 산 화이트는 더 깔끔하고 주방 분위기를 완전히 살려줘서 재구매하길 너무 잘했다는 생각이 듭니다.식세기 처음 사는 분, 작은 주방이라 고민하는 분, 아이 있는 집 모두에게 자신 있게 추천합니다.4년 동안 매일같이 사용해 본 입장에서 돈값 이상 하는 제품이에요.

Sentence (English): It saves me 30-40 minutes of daily hand-washing time, and best of all, it removes grease and grime much more thoroughly than washing dishes by hand.
Comments (English): A true homemaker's review of the Samsung Electronics BESPOKE 6-person countertop dishwasher, purchased with her own money after using it for four years. They say only those who have actually used a dishwasher truly understand its convenience. I've been using this product for over four years, and while reorganizing my new home, I switched from the pink color to the white one. Interestingly, my mother-in-law, mother-in-law, and daughter-in-law all bought new ones after seeing me use it, and they're all very happy with it! Now, I'm buying new ones and recommending it to everyone I know. This dishwasher is truly trustworthy. 1. A homemaker's verdict after four years: I can't live without it. When I first bought it, I was skeptical, wondering, "How useful can this small countertop dishwasher be?" But now, I can honestly say it's the best purchase I've made, next to a washing machine vacuum cleaner. It saves me 30-40 minutes of daily hand-washing time, and best of all, it removes grease and grime much more thoroughly than washing dishes by hand. I have a child, so we handle a lot of dishes, and this product has significantly reduced wrist strain. 2. Why I switched from pink to white. The original pink was beautiful and luxurious, typical of BESPOKE, but the heater malfunctioned, so I moved. With my recent kitchen interior renovation, I thought white would be a better match, so I chose it without hesitation. White is much cleaner, makes the kitchen look more spacious, and goes well with any cabinet tone. Just a color change from the new model completely transformed the kitchen. I only changed the dishwasher, and it feels so much cleaner, so I'm 100% satisfied. 3. Cleaning power: This is the most satisfying aspect of my new dishwasher, which has remained constant for four years. Many dishwasher reviews worry that the small size might compromise cleaning power, but my four years of use have proven otherwise. It cleans dried rice, egg wash, and soup stains perfectly. A greasy frying pan is completely clean on high power. It washes children's plates, bottles, and straw cups without any detergent residue. Glass cups retain a clarity that you can never remove by hand. The glass cups, in particular, are incredibly crisp and clear, incomparable to hand washing. The fine oil film that forms when washing dishes by hand is completely gone, and the cups shine like new. 4. Drying Power: Almost perfect, except for the plastic. After four years of use, I've noticed that the drying power is better than I expected. Ceramics are completely fluffy. Frying pans dry well. Glass cups are almost free of water marks. Plastic sometimes has a few water droplets (a common problem with any dishwasher). However, leaving the door slightly open dries quickly, so it's not a major inconvenience. 5. Noise: I can run it at night. I usually run it at night after putting the kids to bed, and I haven't experienced any noise stress in four years. The sound of the water circulating is faint. It doesn't bother me when watching TV. It's also a plus that it's quiet enough to run at night. 6. Ease of Use: These are the advantages I've noticed from daily use. The simple button controls make it easy for my husband and in-laws to use. The spacious and versatile interior layout makes loading dishes a breeze. It holds 45 rice bowls, 23 soup bowls, plates, and children's plates. Cooking utensils fit easily as long as you adjust the angle. There's no water splashing or leaking (based on 4 years of use). The interior is intuitively wide, not square, making it easy to load. I found this to be much better than other brands. 7. Installation and maintenance are easy even for a single housewife. The first installation wasn't difficult, and I did it myself when I switched to white. Connecting the hose took just a few minutes. Drainage is also easy. Cleaning is easy thanks to the small internal gaps. The filter only needs to be washed once or twice a week. There haven't been any major issues in 4 years. 8. Design: The BESPOKE is truly beautiful. The pink was beautiful, but the white is even prettier. It's simple yet luxurious, and it doesn't have the "space-hogging" feel typical of countertop models. It keeps the kitchen looking organized, and its sophisticated design adds a significant touch to the interior. It's a design that truly pleases every homemaker. Overall Review: A housewife's verdict after using it for four years: a truly self-made purchase. I'm so satisfied that I'd buy it again. No problems in four years. Excellent cleaning power. Satisfactory drying performance. Good noise reduction. The design is top-notch. It improves the quality of life for housewives. In particular, my in-laws, who tried it, bought it right away and are still using it. I think this is the greatest testament to the actual user satisfaction. I liked the pink version, but the white one I bought this time is even neater and perfectly complements the kitchen atmosphere, making me so happy I bought it again. I confidently recommend it to anyone buying a dishwasher for the first time, those considering a small kitchen, or families with children. Having used it daily for four years, I can say that it's more than worth the money.

Comments (English): A true homemaker's review of the Samsung Electronics BESPOKE 6-person countertop dishwasher, purchased with her own money after using it for four years. They say only those who have actually used a dishwasher truly understand its convenience. I've been using this product for over four years, and while reorganizing my new home, I switched from the pink color to the white one. Interestingly, my mother-in-law, mother-in-law, and daughter-in-law all bought new ones after seeing me use it, and they're all very happy with it! Now, I'm buying new ones and recommending it to everyone I know. This dishwasher is truly trustworthy. 1. A homemaker's verdict after four years: I can't live without it. When I first bought it, I was skeptical, wondering, "How useful can this small countertop dishwasher be?" But now, I can honestly say it's the best purchase I've made, next to a washing machine vacuum cleaner. It saves me 30-40 minutes of daily hand-washing time, and best of all, it removes grease and grime much more thoroughly than washing dishes by hand. I have a child, so we handle a lot of dishes, and this product has significantly reduced wrist strain. 2. Why I switched from pink to white. The original pink was beautiful and luxurious, typical of BESPOKE, but the heater malfunctioned, so I moved. With my recent kitchen interior renovation, I thought white would be a better match, so I chose it without hesitation. White is much cleaner, makes the kitchen look more spacious, and goes well with any cabinet tone. Just a color change from the new model completely transformed the kitchen. I only changed the dishwasher, and it feels so much cleaner, so I'm 100% satisfied. 3. Cleaning power: This is the most satisfying aspect of my new dishwasher, which has remained constant for four years. Many dishwasher reviews worry that the small size might compromise cleaning power, but my four years of use have proven otherwise. It cleans dried rice, egg wash, and soup stains perfectly. A greasy frying pan is completely clean on high power. It washes children's plates, bottles, and straw cups without any detergent residue. Glass cups retain a clarity that you can never remove by hand. The glass cups, in particular, are incredibly crisp and clear, incomparable to hand washing. The fine oil film that forms when washing dishes by hand is completely gone, and the cups shine like new. 4. Drying Power: Almost perfect, except for the plastic. After four years of use, I've noticed that the drying power is better than I expected. Ceramics are completely fluffy. Frying pans dry well. Glass cups are almost free of water marks. Plastic sometimes has a few water droplets (a common problem with any dishwasher). However, leaving the door slightly open dries quickly, so it's not a major inconvenience. 5. Noise: I can run it at night. I usually run it at night after putting the kids to bed, and I haven't experienced any noise stress in four years. The sound of the water circulating is faint. It doesn't bother me when watching TV. It's also a plus that it's quiet enough to run at night. 6. Ease of Use: These are the advantages I've noticed from daily use. The simple button controls make it easy for my husband and in-laws to use. The spacious and versatile interior layout makes loading dishes a breeze. It holds 45 rice bowls, 23 soup bowls, plates, and children's plates. Cooking utensils fit easily as long as you adjust the angle. There's no water splashing or leaking (based on 4 years of use). The interior is intuitively wide, not square, making it easy to load. I found this to be much better than other brands. 7. Installation and maintenance are easy even for a single housewife. The first installation wasn't difficult, and I did it myself when I switched to white. Connecting the hose took just a few minutes. Drainage is also easy. Cleaning is easy thanks to the small internal gaps. The filter only needs to be washed once or twice a week. There haven't been any major issues in 4 years. 8. Design: The BESPOKE is truly beautiful. The pink was beautiful, but the white is even prettier. It's simple yet luxurious, and it doesn't have the "space-hogging" feel typical of countertop models. 다음으로 가장 잘 샀다고 말할 수 있어요.매일매일 손 설거지로 30~40분씩 쓰던 시간을 통째로 절약해 주고, 무엇보다도 기름기나 찌든 때가 훨씬 더 깨끗하게 떨어져서 손 설거지보다 깨끗합니다.아이 있는 집이라 식기가 많이 나오는데, 이 제품 덕분에 손목 아픈 일이 확 줄었어요. 2. 핑크 → 화이트로 변경한 이유기존 핑크도 BESPOKE답게 예쁘고 고급스러웠는데, 히터기능이 고장나서 이사도했고 이번에 주방 인테리어를 바꾸면서 화이트가 더 잘 어울릴 것 같아 고민 없이 화이트로 선택했어요.•화이트는 훨씬 더 깔끔하고•주방이 넓어 보이고•어떤 톤의 상부장/하부장에도 잘 어울리고새 제품이랑 색감만 바뀌었을 뿐인데 주방 분위기가 확 달라졌어요.식기세척기 하나만 바꿨는데 깔끔함이 훨씬 살아나는 느낌이라 만족도 100%.️ 3. 세척력 – 4년 동안 변함없이 가장 만족하는 부분여러 식기세척기 후기를 보면 “작아서 세척력이 약하지 않을까?” 이런 걱정을 하는데, 제가 4년을 써 본 결과는 확실합니다.✔ 말라붙은 밥풀, 계란물, 국물 자국 → 깔끔하게 제거됨✔ 기름기 많은 프라이팬 → 강력으로 돌리면 정말 깨끗✔ 아이 식판, 젖병, 빨대컵 → 세제 잔여감 없이 세척됨✔ 유리컵은 손으로 절대 못 내는 투명도가 살아남특히 유리컵의 뽀득함 + 맑은 투명함은 손 설거지와 비교가 안 돼요.손 설거지할 때 생기는 미세 기름막 같은 게 아예 없어지고, 컵이 완전 새 컵처럼 반짝합니다.⸻ 4. 건조력 – 플라스틱만 아니면 거의 완벽함4년 동안 사용하면서 느낀 건 건조력이 생각보다 좋다는 점이에요.•도자기류 → 완전히 뽀송•프라이팬 → 잘 건조됨•유리컵 → 물자국 거의 없음•플라스틱 → 약간 물방울 남을 때 있음 (어느 식기세척기도 공통)하지만 문 열어 조금 열어두면 금방 마르기 때문에 크게 불편하진 않았어요.⸻ 5. 소음 – 밤에도 돌릴 수 있는 수준저는 주로 아이들 재운 뒤 밤에 돌리는 편인데, 4년 동안 소음으로 스트레스를 받은 적이 없어요.•물 도는 소리가 약하게 들리는 정도•TV 볼 때도 신경 안 쓰임•아파트에서도 전혀 문제 없음밤 돌리기 부담 없는 소음 수준이라 이것도 장점.⸻ 6. 사용 편의성 – 주부가 매일 쓰면서 느낀 장점들✔ 버튼 조작이 단순해서 남편, 시부모님도 쉽게 사용✔ 내부 배치가 넓고 다양해서 식기 넣기 편함✔ 밥그릇 45개, 국그릇 23개, 접시, 아이식판 다 들어감✔ 조리도구도 각도만 맞추면 수월하게 들어감✔ 외부 물 튀는 일 없고 물 새는 일 전혀 없음 (4년 사용 기준)특히 내부가 ㄹ자 구조가 아니라 직관적으로 넓게 뻗은 구조라서 넣기가 쉬워요.이 부분은 다른 브랜드보다 훨씬 좋다고 느꼈습니다.⸻ 7. 설치, 관리 – 주부 혼자서도 가능처음 설치할 때도 어렵지 않았고, 이번에 화이트로 바꿀 때도 제가 혼자 설치했어요.•호스 연결 → 몇 분이면 끝•배수도 편함•청소도 내부 틈이 적어서 관리 쉬움•필터는 주 1~2회만 씻어주면 OK4년 동안 특별한 고장 1도 없었습니다.⸻ 8. 디자인 – BESPOKE 진짜 예쁨핑크도 예뻤지만 화이트는 정말 더 예뻐요.심플하면서 고급스럽고, 특히 카운터탑 타입 특유의 ‘공간 차지하는 느낌’이 거의 없습니다.주방이 정돈돼 보이고, 세련된 분위기라 인테리어 효과도 커요.주부의 눈을 만족시키는 디자인이라는 게 가장 정확해요.⸻ 총평: 4년 써본 주부의 진짜 내돈내산 결론✔ 다시 사라면 또 살 만큼 만족도 높음✔ 4년 동안 고장 없음✔ 세척력 → 뛰어남✔ 건조력 → 만족✔ 소음 → 양호✔ 디자인 → 최고✔ 주부 삶의 질이 올라감특히“이 제품 써본 시댁 아가씨도 바로 사서 지금도 잘 쓰고 있다”는 부분이 실사용자 만족도를 말해주는 가장 큰 증거라고 생각해요.핑크 버전도 좋았지만, 이번에 산 화이트는 더 깔끔하고 주방 분위기를 완전히 살려줘서 재구매하길 너무 잘했다는 생각이 듭니다.식세기 처음 사는 분, 작은 주방이라 고민하는 분, 아이 있는 집 모두에게 자신 있게 추천합니다.4년 동안 매일같이 사용해 본 입장에서 돈값 이상 하는 제품이에요.

Sentence (English): Why I switched from pink to white.
Comments (English): A true homemaker's review of the Samsung Electronics BESPOKE 6-person countertop dishwasher, purchased with her own money after using it for four years. They say only those who have actually used a dishwasher truly understand its convenience. I've been using this product for over four years, and while reorganizing my new home, I switched from the pink color to the white one. Interestingly, my mother-in-law, mother-in-law, and daughter-in-law all bought new ones after seeing me use it, and they're all very happy with it! Now, I'm buying new ones and recommending it to everyone I know. This dishwasher is truly trustworthy. 1. A homemaker's verdict after four years: I can't live without it. When I first bought it, I was skeptical, wondering, "How useful can this small countertop dishwasher be?" But now, I can honestly say it's the best purchase I've made, next to a washing machine vacuum cleaner. It saves me 30-40 minutes of daily hand-washing time, and best of all, it removes grease and grime much more thoroughly than washing dishes by hand. I have a child, so we handle a lot of dishes, and this product has significantly reduced wrist strain. 2. Why I switched from pink to white. The original pink was beautiful and luxurious, typical of BESPOKE, but the heater malfunctioned, so I moved. With my recent kitchen interior renovation, I thought white would be a better match, so I chose it without hesitation. White is much cleaner, makes the kitchen look more spacious, and goes well with any cabinet tone. Just a color change from the new model completely transformed the kitchen. I only changed the dishwasher, and it feels so much cleaner, so I'm 100% satisfied. 3. Cleaning power: This is the most satisfying aspect of my new dishwasher, which has remained constant for four years. Many dishwasher reviews worry that the small size might compromise cleaning power, but my four years of use have proven otherwise. It cleans dried rice, egg wash, and soup stains perfectly. A greasy frying pan is completely clean on high power. It washes children's plates, bottles, and straw cups without any detergent residue. Glass cups retain a clarity that you can never remove by hand. The glass cups, in particular, are incredibly crisp and clear, incomparable to hand washing. The fine oil film that forms when washing dishes by hand is completely gone, and the cups shine like new. 4. Drying Power: Almost perfect, except for the plastic. After four years of use, I've noticed that the drying power is better than I expected. Ceramics are completely fluffy. Frying pans dry well. Glass cups are almost free of water marks. Plastic sometimes has a few water droplets (a common problem with any dishwasher). However, leaving the door slightly open dries quickly, so it's not a major inconvenience. 5. Noise: I can run it at night. I usually run it at night after putting the kids to bed, and I haven't experienced any noise stress in four years. The sound of the water circulating is faint. It doesn't bother me when watching TV. It's also a plus that it's quiet enough to run at night. 6. Ease of Use: These are the advantages I've noticed from daily use. The simple button controls make it easy for my husband and in-laws to use. The spacious and versatile interior layout makes loading dishes a breeze. It holds 45 rice bowls, 23 soup bowls, plates, and children's plates. Cooking utensils fit easily as long as you adjust the angle. There's no water splashing or leaking (based on 4 years of use). The interior is intuitively wide, not square, making it easy to load. I found this to be much better than other brands. 7. Installation and maintenance are easy even for a single housewife. The first installation wasn't difficult, and I did it myself when I switched to white. Connecting the hose took just a few minutes. Drainage is also easy. Cleaning is easy thanks to the small internal gaps. The filter only needs to be washed once or twice a week. There haven't been any major issues in 4 years. 8. Design: The BESPOKE is truly beautiful. The pink was beautiful, but the white is even prettier. It's simple yet luxurious, and it doesn't have the "space-hogging" feel typical of countertop models. It keeps the kitchen looking organized, and its sophisticated design adds a significant touch to the interior. It's a design that truly pleases every homemaker. Overall Review: A housewife's verdict after using it for four years: a truly self-made purchase. I'm so satisfied that I'd buy it again. No problems in four years. Excellent cleaning power. Satisfactory drying performance. Good noise reduction. The design is top-notch. It improves the quality of life for housewives. In particular, my in-laws, who tried it, bought it right away and are still using it. I think this is the greatest testament to the actual user satisfaction. I liked the pink version, but the white one I bought this time is even neater and perfectly complements the kitchen atmosphere, making me so happy I bought it again. I confidently recommend it to anyone buying a dishwasher for the first time, those considering a small kitchen, or families with children. Having used it daily for four years, I can say that it's more than worth the money.
