Sentence (English): White is much cleaner, makes the kitchen look more spacious, and goes well with any cabinet tone.
Comments (English): A true homemaker's review of the Samsung Electronics BESPOKE 6-person countertop dishwasher, purchased with her own money after using it for four years. They say only those who have actually used a dishwasher truly understand its convenience. I've been using this product for over four years, and while reorganizing my new home, I switched from the pink color to the white one. Interestingly, my mother-in-law, mother-in-law, and daughter-in-law all bought new ones after seeing me use it, and they're all very happy with it! Now, I'm buying new ones and recommending it to everyone I know. This dishwasher is truly trustworthy. 1. A homemaker's verdict after four years: I can't live without it. When I first bought it, I was skeptical, wondering, "How useful can this small countertop dishwasher be?" But now, I can honestly say it's the best purchase I've made, next to a washing machine vacuum cleaner. It saves me 30-40 minutes of daily hand-washing time, and best of all, it removes grease and grime much more thoroughly than washing dishes by hand. I have a child, so we handle a lot of dishes, and this product has significantly reduced wrist strain. 2. Why I switched from pink to white. The original pink was beautiful and luxurious, typical of BESPOKE, but the heater malfunctioned, so I moved. With my recent kitchen interior renovation, I thought white would be a better match, so I chose it without hesitation. White is much cleaner, makes the kitchen look more spacious, and goes well with any cabinet tone. Just a color change from the new model completely transformed the kitchen. I only changed the dishwasher, and it feels so much cleaner, so I'm 100% satisfied. 3. Cleaning power: This is the most satisfying aspect of my new dishwasher, which has remained constant for four years. Many dishwasher reviews worry that the small size might compromise cleaning power, but my four years of use have proven otherwise. It cleans dried rice, egg wash, and soup stains perfectly. A greasy frying pan is completely clean on high power. It washes children's plates, bottles, and straw cups without any detergent residue. Glass cups retain a clarity that you can never remove by hand. The glass cups, in particular, are incredibly crisp and clear, incomparable to hand washing. The fine oil film that forms when washing dishes by hand is completely gone, and the cups shine like new. 4. Drying Power: Almost perfect, except for the plastic. After four years of use, I've noticed that the drying power is better than I expected. Ceramics are completely fluffy. Frying pans dry well. Glass cups are almost free of water marks. Plastic sometimes has a few water droplets (a common problem with any dishwasher). However, leaving the door slightly open dries quickly, so it's not a major inconvenience. 5. Noise: I can run it at night. I usually run it at night after putting the kids to bed, and I haven't experienced any noise stress in four years. The sound of the water circulating is faint. It doesn't bother me when watching TV. It's also a plus that it's quiet enough to run at night. 6. Ease of Use: These are the advantages I've noticed from daily use. The simple button controls make it easy for my husband and in-laws to use. The spacious and versatile interior layout makes loading dishes a breeze. It holds 45 rice bowls, 23 soup bowls, plates, and children's plates. Cooking utensils fit easily as long as you adjust the angle. There's no water splashing or leaking (based on 4 years of use). The interior is intuitively wide, not square, making it easy to load. I found this to be much better than other brands. 7. Installation and maintenance are easy even for a single housewife. The first installation wasn't difficult, and I did it myself when I switched to white. Connecting the hose took just a few minutes. Drainage is also easy. Cleaning is easy thanks to the small internal gaps. The filter only needs to be washed once or twice a week. There haven't been any major issues in 4 years. 8. Design: The BESPOKE is truly beautiful. The pink was beautiful, but the white is even prettier. It's simple yet luxurious, and it doesn't have the "space-hogging" feel typical of countertop models. It keeps the kitchen looking organized, and its sophisticated design adds a significant touch to the interior. It's a design that truly pleases every homemaker. Overall Review: A housewife's verdict after using it for four years: a truly self-made purchase. I'm so satisfied that I'd buy it again. No problems in four years. Excellent cleaning power. Satisfactory drying performance. Good noise reduction. The design is top-notch. It improves the quality of life for housewives. In particular, my in-laws, who tried it, bought it right away and are still using it. I think this is the greatest testament to the actual user satisfaction. I liked the pink version, but the white one I bought this time is even neater and perfectly complements the kitchen atmosphere, making me so happy I bought it again. I confidently recommend it to anyone buying a dishwasher for the first time, those considering a small kitchen, or families with children. Having used it daily for four years, I can say that it's more than worth the money.

Comments (English): A true homemaker's review of the Samsung Electronics BESPOKE 6-person countertop dishwasher, purchased with her own money after using it for four years. They say only those who have actually used a dishwasher truly understand its convenience. I've been using this product for over four years, and while reorganizing my new home, I switched from the pink color to the white one. Interestingly, my mother-in-law, mother-in-law, and daughter-in-law all bought new ones after seeing me use it, and they're all very happy with it! Now, I'm buying new ones and recommending it to everyone I know. This dishwasher is truly trustworthy. 1. A homemaker's verdict after four years: I can't live without it. When I first bought it, I was skeptical, wondering, "How useful can this small countertop dishwasher be?" But now, I can honestly say it's the best purchase I've made, next to a washing machine vacuum cleaner. It saves me 30-40 minutes of daily hand-washing time, and best of all, it removes grease and grime much more thoroughly than washing dishes by hand. I have a child, so we handle a lot of dishes, and this product has significantly reduced wrist strain. 2. Why I switched from pink to white. The original pink was beautiful and luxurious, typical of BESPOKE, but the heater malfunctioned, so I moved. With my recent kitchen interior renovation, I thought white would be a better match, so I chose it without hesitation. White is much cleaner, makes the kitchen look more spacious, and goes well with any cabinet tone. Just a color change from the new model completely transformed the kitchen. I only changed the dishwasher, and it feels so much cleaner, so I'm 100% satisfied. 3. Cleaning power: This is the most satisfying aspect of my new dishwasher, which has remained constant for four years. Many dishwasher reviews worry that the small size might compromise cleaning power, but my four years of use have proven otherwise. It cleans dried rice, egg wash, and soup stains perfectly. A greasy frying pan is completely clean on high power. It washes children's plates, bottles, and straw cups without any detergent residue. Glass cups retain a clarity that you can never remove by hand. The glass cups, in particular, are incredibly crisp and clear, incomparable to hand washing. The fine oil film that forms when washing dishes by hand is completely gone, and the cups shine like new. 4. Drying Power: Almost perfect, except for the plastic. After four years of use, I've noticed that the drying power is better than I expected. Ceramics are completely fluffy. Frying pans dry well. Glass cups are almost free of water marks. Plastic sometimes has a few water droplets (a common problem with any dishwasher). However, leaving the door slightly open dries quickly, so it's not a major inconvenience. 5. Noise: I can run it at night. I usually run it at night after putting the kids to bed, and I haven't experienced any noise stress in four years. The sound of the water circulating is faint. It doesn't bother me when watching TV. It's also a plus that it's quiet enough to run at night. 6. Ease of Use: These are the advantages I've noticed from daily use. The simple button controls make it easy for my husband and in-laws to use. The spacious and versatile interior layout makes loading dishes a breeze. It holds 45 rice bowls, 23 soup bowls, plates, and children's plates. Cooking utensils fit easily as long as you adjust the angle. There's no water splashing or leaking (based on 4 years of use). The interior is intuitively wide, not square, making it easy to load. I found this to be much better than other brands. 7. Installation and maintenance are easy even for a single housewife. The first installation wasn't difficult, and I did it myself when I switched to white. Connecting the hose took just a few minutes. Drainage is also easy. Cleaning is easy thanks to the small internal gaps. The filter only needs to be washed once or twice a week. There haven't been any major issues in 4 years. 8. Design: The BESPOKE is truly beautiful. The pink was beautiful, but the white is even prettier. It's simple yet luxurious, and it doesn't have the "space-hogging" feel typical of countertop models. It keeps the kitchen looking organized, and its sophisticated design adds a significant touch to the interior. It's a design that truly pleases every homemaker. Overall Review: A housewife's verdict after using it for four years: a truly self-made purchase. I'm so satisfied that I'd buy it again. No problems in four years. Excellent cleaning power. Satisfactory drying performance. Good noise reduction. The design is top-notch. It improves the quality of life for housewives. In particular, my in-laws, who tried it, bought it right away and are still using it. I think this is the greatest testament to the actual user satisfaction. I liked the pink version, but the white one I bought this time is even neater and perfectly complements the kitchen atmosphere, making me so happy I bought it again. I confidently recommend it to anyone buying a dishwasher for the first time, those considering a small kitchen, or families with children. Having used it daily for four years, I can say that it's more than worth the money.

When I first bought it, I was skeptical, wondering, "How useful can this small countertop dishwasher be?" But now, I can honestly say it's the best purchase I've made, next to a washing machine vacuum cleaner. It saves me 30-40 minutes of daily hand-washing time, and best of all, it removes grease and grime much more thoroughly than washing dishes by hand. I have a child, so we handle a lot of dishes, and this product has significantly reduced wrist strain. 2. Why I switched from pink to white. The original pink was beautiful and luxurious, typical of BESPOKE, but the heater malfunctioned, so I moved. With my recent kitchen interior renovation, I thought white would be a better match, so I chose it without hesitation. I only changed the dishwasher, and it feels so much cleaner, so I'm 100% satisfied. 3. Many dishwasher reviews worry that the small size might compromise cleaning power, but my four years of use have proven otherwise. It cleans dried rice, egg wash, and soup stains perfectly. A greasy frying pan is completely clean on high power. It washes children's plates, bottles, and straw cups without any detergent residue. Glass cups retain a clarity that you can never remove by hand. The glass cups, in particular, are incredibly crisp and clear, incomparable to hand washing. The fine oil film that forms when washing dishes by hand is completely gone, and the cups shine like new. 4. Drying Power: Almost perfect, except for the plastic. After four years of use, I've noticed that the drying power is better than I expected. Ceramics are completely fluffy. Frying pans dry well. Glass cups are almost free of water marks. Plastic sometimes has a few water droplets (a common problem with any dishwasher). However, leaving the door slightly open dries quickly, so it's not a major inconvenience. 5. Noise: I can run it at night. I usually run it at night after putting the kids to bed, and I haven't experienced any noise stress in four years. The sound of the water circulating is faint. It doesn't bother me when watching TV. It's also a plus that it's quiet enough to run at night. 6. Ease of Use: These are the advantages I've noticed from daily use. The simple button controls make it easy for my husband and in-laws to use. The spacious and versatile interior layout makes loading dishes a breeze. It holds 45 rice bowls, 23 soup bowls, plates, and children's plates. Cooking utensils fit easily as long as you adjust the angle. There's no water splashing or leaking (based on 4 years of use). The interior is intuitively wide, not square, making it easy to load. I found this to be much better than other brands. 7. Installation and maintenance are easy even for a single housewife. The first installation wasn't difficult, and I did it myself when I switched to white. Connecting the hose took just a few minutes. Drainage is also easy. Cleaning is easy thanks to the small internal gaps. The filter only needs to be washed once or twice a week. There haven't been any major issues in 4 years. 8. Design: The BESPOKE is truly beautiful. The pink was beautiful, but the white is even prettier. It's simple yet luxurious, and it doesn't have the "space-hogging" feel typical of countertop models. It keeps the kitchen looking organized, and its sophisticated design adds a significant touch to the interior. It's a design that truly pleases every homemaker. Overall Review: A housewife's verdict after using it for four years: a truly self-made purchase. I'm so satisfied that I'd buy it again. No problems in four years. Excellent cleaning power. Satisfactory drying performance. Good noise reduction. The design is top-notch. It improves the quality of life for housewives. In particular, my in-laws, who tried it, bought it right away and are still using it. I think this is the greatest testament to the actual user satisfaction. I liked the pink version, but the white one I bought this time is even neater and perfectly complements the kitchen atmosphere, making me so happy I bought it again. I confidently recommend it to anyone buying a dishwasher for the first time, those considering a small kitchen, or families with children. Having used it daily for four years, I can say that it's more than worth the money.

Comments (English): A true homemaker's review of the Samsung Electronics BESPOKE 6-person countertop dishwasher, purchased with her own money after using it for four years. They say only those who have actually used a dishwasher truly understand its convenience. I've been using this product for over four years, and while reorganizing my new home, I switched from the pink color to the white one. Interestingly, my mother-in-law, mother-in-law, and daughter-in-law all bought new ones after seeing me use it, and they're all very happy with it! Now, I'm buying new ones and recommending it to everyone I know. This dishwasher is truly trustworthy. 1. A homemaker's verdict after four years: I can't live without it. When I first bought it, I was skeptical, wondering, "How useful can this small countertop dishwasher be?" But now, I can honestly say it's the best purchase I've made, next to a washing machine vacuum cleaner. It saves me 30-40 minutes of daily hand-washing time, and best of all, it removes grease and grime much more thoroughly than washing dishes by hand. I have a child, so we handle a lot of dishes, and this product has significantly reduced wrist strain. 2. Why I switched from pink to white. The original pink was beautiful and luxurious, typical of BESPOKE, but the heater malfunctioned, so I moved. With my recent kitchen interior renovation, I thought white would be a better match, so I chose it without hesitation. White is much cleaner, makes the kitchen look more spacious, and goes well with any cabinet tone. Just a color change from the new model completely transformed the kitchen. I only changed the dishwasher, and it feels so much cleaner, so I'm 100% satisfied. 3. Cleaning power: This is the most satisfying aspect of my new dishwasher, which has remained constant for four years. Many dishwasher reviews worry that the small size might compromise cleaning power, but my four years of use have proven otherwise. It cleans dried rice, egg wash, and soup stains perfectly. A greasy frying pan is completely clean on high power. It washes children's plates, bottles, and straw cups without any detergent residue. Glass cups retain a clarity that you can never remove by hand. The glass cups, in particular, are incredibly crisp and clear, incomparable to hand washing. The fine oil film that forms when washing dishes by hand is completely gone, and the cups shine like new. 4. Drying Power: Almost perfect, except for the plastic. After four years of use, I've noticed that the drying power is better than I expected. Ceramics are completely fluffy. Frying pans dry well. Glass cups are almost free of water marks. Plastic sometimes has a few water droplets (a common problem with any dishwasher). However, leaving the door slightly open dries quickly, so it's not a major inconvenience. 5. Noise: I can run it at night. I usually run it at night after putting the kids to bed, and I haven't experienced any noise stress in four years. The sound of the water circulating is faint. It doesn't bother me when watching TV. It's also a plus that it's quiet enough to run at night. 6. Ease of Use: These are the advantages I've noticed from daily use. The simple button controls make it easy for my husband and in-laws to use. The spacious and versatile interior layout makes loading dishes a breeze. It holds 45 rice bowls, 23 soup bowls, plates, and children's plates. Cooking utensils fit easily as long as you adjust the angle. There's no water splashing or leaking (based on 4 years of use). The interior is intuitively wide, not square, making it easy to load. I found this to be much better than other brands. 7. Installation and maintenance are easy even for a single housewife. The first installation wasn't difficult, and I did it myself when I switched to white. Connecting the hose took just a few minutes. Drainage is also easy. Cleaning is easy thanks to the small internal gaps. The filter only needs to be washed once or twice a week. There haven't been any major issues in 4 years. 8. Design: The BESPOKE is truly beautiful. The pink was beautiful, but the white is even prettier. It's simple yet luxurious, and it doesn't have the "space-hogging" feel typical of countertop models. It keeps the kitchen looking organized, and its sophisticated design adds a significant touch to the interior. It's a design that truly pleases every homemaker. Overall Review: A housewife's verdict after using it for four years: a truly self-made purchase. I'm so satisfied that I'd buy it again. No problems in four years. Excellent cleaning power. Satisfactory drying performance. Good noise reduction. The design is top-notch. It improves the quality of life for housewives. In particular, my in-laws, who tried it, bought it right away and are still using it. I think this is the greatest testament to the actual user satisfaction. I liked the pink version, but the white one I bought this time is even neater and perfectly complements the kitchen atmosphere, making me so happy I bought it again. I confidently recommend it to anyone buying a dishwasher for the first time, those considering a small kitchen, or families with children. Having used it daily for four years, I can say that it's more than worth the money.

고급스러웠는데, 히터기능이 고장나서 이사도했고 이번에 주방 인테리어를 바꾸면서 화이트가 더 잘 어울릴 것 같아 고민 없이 화이트로 선택했어요.•화이트는 훨씬 더 깔끔하고•주방이 넓어 보이고•어떤 톤의 상부장/하부장에도 잘 어울리고새 제품이랑 색감만 바뀌었을 뿐인데 주방 분위기가 확 달라졌어요.식기세척기 하나만 바꿨는데 깔끔함이 훨씬 살아나는 느낌이라 만족도 Sentence (English): After four years of use, I've noticed that the drying power is better than I expected.
Comments (English): A true homemaker's review of the Samsung Electronics BESPOKE 6-person countertop dishwasher, purchased with her own money after using it for four years. They say only those who have actually used a dishwasher truly understand its convenience. I've been using this product for over four years, and while reorganizing my new home, I switched from the pink color to the white one. Interestingly, my mother-in-law, mother-in-law, and daughter-in-law all bought new ones after seeing me use it, and they're all very happy with it! Now, I'm buying new ones and recommending it to everyone I know. This dishwasher is truly trustworthy. 1. A homemaker's verdict after four years: I can't live without it. When I first bought it, I was skeptical, wondering, "How useful can this small countertop dishwasher be?" But now, I can honestly say it's the best purchase I've made, next to a washing machine vacuum cleaner. It saves me 30-40 minutes of daily hand-washing time, and best of all, it removes grease and grime much more thoroughly than washing dishes by hand. I have a child, so we handle a lot of dishes, and this product has significantly reduced wrist strain. 2. Why I switched from pink to white. The original pink was beautiful and luxurious, typical of BESPOKE, but the heater malfunctioned, so I moved. With my recent kitchen interior renovation, I thought white would be a better match, so I chose it without hesitation. White is much cleaner, makes the kitchen look more spacious, and goes well with any cabinet tone. Just a color change from the new model completely transformed the kitchen. I only changed the dishwasher, and it feels so much cleaner, so I'm 100% satisfied. 3. Cleaning power: This is the most satisfying aspect of my new dishwasher, which has remained constant for four years. Many dishwasher reviews worry that the small size might compromise cleaning power, but my four years of use have proven otherwise. It cleans dried rice, egg wash, and soup stains perfectly. A greasy frying pan is completely clean on high power. It washes children's plates, bottles, and straw cups without any detergent residue. Glass cups retain a clarity that you can never remove by hand. The glass cups, in particular, are incredibly crisp and clear, incomparable to hand washing. The fine oil film that forms when washing dishes by hand is completely gone, and the cups shine like new. 4. Drying Power: Almost perfect, except for the plastic. After four years of use, I've noticed that the drying power is better than I expected. Ceramics are completely fluffy. Frying pans dry well. Glass cups are almost free of water marks. Plastic sometimes has a few water droplets (a common problem with any dishwasher). However, leaving the door slightly open dries quickly, so it's not a major inconvenience. 5. Noise: I can run it at night. I usually run it at night after putting the kids to bed, and I haven't experienced any noise stress in four years. The sound of the water circulating is faint. It doesn't bother me when watching TV. It's also a plus that it's quiet enough to run at night. 6. Ease of Use: These are the advantages I've noticed from daily use. The simple button controls make it easy for my husband and in-laws to use. The spacious and versatile interior layout makes loading dishes a breeze. It holds 45 rice bowls, 23 soup bowls, plates, and children's plates. Cooking utensils fit easily as long as you adjust the angle. There's no water splashing or leaking (based on 4 years of use). The interior is intuitively wide, not square, making it easy to load. I found this to be much better than other brands. 7. Installation and maintenance are easy even for a single housewife. The first installation wasn't difficult, and I did it myself when I switched to white. Connecting the hose took just a few minutes. Drainage is also easy. Cleaning is easy thanks to the small internal gaps. The filter only needs to be washed once or twice a week. There haven't been any major issues in 4 years. 8. Design: The BESPOKE is truly beautiful. The pink was beautiful, but the white is even prettier. It's simple yet luxurious, and it doesn't have the "space-hogging" feel typical of countertop models. It keeps the kitchen looking organized, and its sophisticated design adds a significant touch to the interior. It's a design that truly pleases every homemaker. Overall Review: A housewife's verdict after using it for four years: a truly self-made purchase. I'm so satisfied that I'd buy it again. No problems in four years. Excellent cleaning power. Satisfactory drying performance. Good noise reduction. The design is top-notch. It improves the quality of life for housewives. In particular, my in-laws, who tried it, bought it right away and are still using it. I think this is the greatest testament to the actual user satisfaction. I liked the pink version, but the white one I bought this time is even neater and perfectly complements the kitchen atmosphere, making me so happy I bought it again. I confidently recommend it to anyone buying a dishwasher for the first time, those considering a small kitchen, or families with children. Having used it daily for four years, I can say that it's more than worth the money.

Comments (English): A true homemaker's review of the Samsung Electronics BESPOKE 6-person countertop dishwasher, purchased with her own money after using it for four years. They say only those who have actually used a dishwasher truly understand its convenience. I've been using this product for over four years, and while reorganizing my new home, I switched from the pink color to the white one. Interestingly, my mother-in-law, mother-in-law, and daughter-in-law all bought new ones after seeing me use it, and they're all very happy with it! Now, I'm buying new ones and recommending it to everyone I know. This dishwasher is truly trustworthy. 1. A homemaker's verdict after four years: I can't live without it. When I first bought it, I was skeptical, wondering, "How useful can this small countertop dishwasher be?" But now, I can honestly say it's the best purchase I've made, next to a washing machine vacuum cleaner. It saves me 30-40 minutes of daily hand-washing time, and best of all, it removes grease and grime much more thoroughly than washing dishes by hand. I have a child, so we handle a lot of dishes, and this product has significantly reduced wrist strain. 2. Why I switched from pink to white. The original pink was beautiful and luxurious, typical of BESPOKE, but the heater malfunctioned, so I moved. With my recent kitchen interior renovation, I thought white would be a better match, so I chose it without hesitation. White is much cleaner, makes the kitchen look more spacious, and goes well with any cabinet tone. Just a color change from the new model completely transformed the kitchen. I only changed the dishwasher, and it feels so much cleaner, so I'm 100% satisfied. 3. Cleaning power: This is the most satisfying aspect of my new dishwasher, which has remained constant for four years. Many dishwasher reviews worry that the small size might compromise cleaning power, but my four years of use have proven otherwise. It cleans dried rice, egg wash, and soup stains perfectly. A greasy frying pan is completely clean on high power. It washes children's plates, bottles, and straw cups without any detergent residue. Glass cups retain a clarity that you can never remove by hand. The glass cups, in particular, are incredibly crisp and clear, incomparable to hand washing. The fine oil film that forms when washing dishes by hand is completely gone, and the cups shine like new. 4. Drying Power: Almost perfect, except for the plastic. After four years of use, I've noticed that the drying power is better than I expected. Ceramics are completely fluffy. Frying pans dry well. Glass cups are almost free of water marks. Plastic sometimes has a few water droplets (a common problem with any dishwasher). However, leaving the door slightly open dries quickly, so it's not a major inconvenience. 5. Noise: I can run it at night. I usually run it at night after putting the kids to bed, and I haven't experienced any noise stress in four years. The sound of the water circulating is faint. It doesn't bother me when watching TV. It's also a plus that it's quiet enough to run at night. 6. Ease of Use: These are the advantages I've noticed from daily use. The simple button controls make it easy for my husband and in-laws to use. The spacious and versatile interior layout makes loading dishes a breeze. It holds 45 rice bowls, 23 soup bowls, plates, and children's plates. Cooking utensils fit easily as long as you adjust the angle. There's no water splashing or leaking (based on 4 years of use). The interior is intuitively wide, not square, making it easy to load. I found this to be much better than other brands. 7. Installation and maintenance are easy even for a single housewife. The first installation wasn't difficult, and I did it myself when I switched to white. Connecting the hose took just a few minutes. Drainage is also easy. Cleaning is easy thanks to the small internal gaps. The filter only needs to be washed once or twice a week. There haven't been any major issues in 4 years. 8. Design: The BESPOKE is truly beautiful. The pink was beautiful, but the white is even prettier. It's simple yet luxurious, and it doesn't have the "space-hogging" feel typical of countertop models. It keeps the kitchen looking organized, and its sophisticated design adds a significant touch to the interior. It's a design that truly pleases every homemaker. Overall Review: A housewife's verdict after using it for four years: a truly self-made purchase. I'm so satisfied that I'd buy it again. No problems in four years. Excellent cleaning power. Satisfactory drying performance. Good noise reduction. The design is top-notch. It improves the quality of life for housewives. In particular, my in-laws, who tried it, bought it right away and are still using it. I think this is the greatest testament to the actual user satisfaction. I liked the pink version, but the white one I bought this time is even neater and perfectly complements the kitchen atmosphere, making me so happy I bought it again. I confidently recommend it to anyone buying a dishwasher for the first time, those considering a small kitchen, or families with children. Having used it daily for four years, I can say that it's more than worth the money.

Comments (English): A true homemaker's review of the Samsung Electronics BESPOKE 6-person countertop dishwasher, purchased with her own money after using it for four years. They say only those who have actually used a dishwasher truly understand its convenience. I've been using this product for over four years, and while reorganizing my new home, I switched from the pink color to the white one. Interestingly, my mother-in-law, mother-in-law, and daughter-in-law all bought new ones after seeing me use it, and they're all very happy with it! Now, I'm buying new ones and recommending it to everyone I know. This dishwasher is truly trustworthy. 1. A homemaker's verdict after four years: I can't live without it. When I first bought it, I was skeptical, wondering, "How useful can this small countertop dishwasher be?" But now, I can honestly say it's the best purchase I've made, next to a washing machine vacuum cleaner. It saves me 30-40 minutes of daily hand-washing time, and best of all, it removes grease and grime much more thoroughly than washing dishes by hand. I have a child, so we handle a lot of dishes, and this product has significantly reduced wrist strain. 2. Why I switched from pink to white. The original pink was beautiful and luxurious, typical of BESPOKE, but the heater malfunctioned, so I moved. With my recent kitchen interior renovation, I thought white would be a better match, so I chose it without hesitation. White is much cleaner, makes the kitchen look more spacious, and goes well with any cabinet tone. Just a color change from the new model completely transformed the kitchen. I only changed the dishwasher, and it feels so much cleaner, so I'm 100% satisfied. 3. Cleaning power: This is the most satisfying aspect of my new dishwasher, which has remained constant for four years. Many dishwasher reviews worry that the small size might compromise cleaning power, but my four years of use have proven otherwise. It cleans dried rice, egg wash, and soup stains perfectly. A greasy frying pan is completely clean on high power. It washes children's plates, bottles, and straw cups without any detergent residue. Glass cups retain a clarity that you can never remove by hand. The glass cups, in particular, are incredibly crisp and clear, incomparable to hand washing. The fine oil film that forms when washing dishes by hand is completely gone, and the cups shine like new. 4. Drying Power: Almost perfect, except for the plastic. After four years of use, I've noticed that the drying power is better than I expected. Ceramics are completely fluffy. Frying pans dry well. Glass cups are almost free of water marks. Plastic sometimes has a few water droplets (a common problem with any dishwasher). However, leaving the door slightly open dries quickly, so it's not a major inconvenience. 5. Noise: I can run it at night. I usually run it at night after putting the kids to bed, and I haven't experienced any noise stress in four years. The sound of the water circulating is faint. It doesn't bother me when watching TV. It's also a plus that it's quiet enough to run at night. 6. Ease of Use: These are the advantages I've noticed from daily use. The simple button controls make it easy for my husband and in-laws to use. The spacious and versatile interior layout makes loading dishes a breeze. It holds 45 rice bowls, 23 soup bowls, plates, and children's plates. Cooking utensils fit easily as long as you adjust the angle. There's no water splashing or leaking (based on 4 years of use). The interior is intuitively wide, not square, making it easy to load. I found this to be much better than other brands. 7. Installation and maintenance are easy even for a single housewife. The first installation wasn't difficult, and I did it myself when I switched to white. Connecting the hose took just a few minutes. Drainage is also easy. Cleaning is easy thanks to the small internal gaps. The filter only needs to be washed once or twice a week. There haven't been any major issues in 4 years. 8. Design: The BESPOKE is truly beautiful. The pink was beautiful, but the white is even prettier. It's simple yet luxurious, and it doesn't have the "space-hogging" feel typical of countertop models. It keeps the kitchen looking organized, and its sophisticated design adds a significant touch to the interior. It's a design that truly pleases every homemaker. Overall Review: A housewife's verdict after using it for four years: a truly self-made purchase. I'm so satisfied that I'd buy it again. No problems in four years. Excellent cleaning power. Satisfactory drying performance. Good noise reduction. The design is top-notch. It improves the quality of life for housewives. In particular, my in-laws, who tried it, bought it right away and are still using it. I think this is the greatest testament to the actual user satisfaction. I liked the pink version, but the white one I bought this time is even neater and perfectly complements the kitchen atmosphere, making me so happy I bought it again. I confidently recommend it to anyone buying a dishwasher for the first time, those considering a small kitchen, or families with children. Having used it daily for four years, I can say that it's more than worth the money.

But now, I can honestly say it's the best purchase I've made, next to a washing machine vacuum cleaner. It saves me 30-40 minutes of daily hand-washing time, and best of all, it removes grease and grime much more thoroughly than washing dishes by hand. I have a child, so we handle a lot of dishes, and this product has significantly reduced wrist strain. 2. Why I switched from pink to white. The original pink was beautiful and luxurious, typical of BESPOKE, but the heater malfunctioned, so I moved. With my recent kitchen interior renovation, I thought white would be a better match, so I chose it without hesitation. I only changed the dishwasher, and it feels so much cleaner, so I'm 100% satisfied. 3. Glass cups retain a clarity that you can never remove by hand. The glass cups, in particular, are incredibly crisp and clear, incomparable to hand washing. The fine oil film that forms when washing dishes by hand is completely gone, and the cups shine like new. 4. Drying Power: Almost perfect, except for the plastic. After four years of use, I've noticed that the drying power is better than I expected. Ceramics are completely fluffy. Frying pans dry well. Glass cups are almost free of water marks. Plastic sometimes has a few water droplets (a common problem with any dishwasher). However, leaving the door slightly open dries quickly, so it's not a major inconvenience. 5. Noise: I can run it at night. I usually run it at night after putting the kids to bed, and I haven't experienced any noise stress in four years. The sound of the water circulating is faint. It doesn't bother me when watching TV. It's also a plus that it's quiet enough to run at night. 6. Ease of Use: These are the advantages I've noticed from daily use. The simple button controls make it easy for my husband and in-laws to use. The spacious and versatile interior layout makes loading dishes a breeze. It holds 45 rice bowls, 23 soup bowls, plates, and children's plates. Cooking utensils fit easily as long as you adjust the angle. There's no water splashing or leaking (based on 4 years of use). The interior is intuitively wide, not square, making it easy to load. I found this to be much better than other brands. 7. Installation and maintenance are easy even for a single housewife. The first installation wasn't difficult, and I did it myself when I switched to white. Connecting the hose took just a few minutes. Drainage is also easy. Cleaning is easy thanks to the small internal gaps. The filter only needs to be washed once or twice a week. There haven't been any major issues in 4 years. 8. Design: The BESPOKE is truly beautiful. The pink was beautiful, but the white is even prettier. It's simple yet luxurious, and it doesn't have the "space-hogging" feel typical of countertop models. It keeps the kitchen looking organized, and its sophisticated design adds a significant touch to the interior. It's a design that truly pleases every homemaker. Overall Review: A housewife's verdict after using it for four years: a truly self-made purchase. I'm so satisfied that I'd buy it again. No problems in four years. Excellent cleaning power. Satisfactory drying performance. Good noise reduction. The design is top-notch. It improves the quality of life for housewives. In particular, my in-laws, who tried it, bought it right away and are still using it. I think this is the greatest testament to the actual user satisfaction. I liked the pink version, but the white one I bought this time is even neater and perfectly complements the kitchen atmosphere, making me so happy I bought it again. I confidently recommend it to anyone buying a dishwasher for the first time, those considering a small kitchen, or families with children. Having used it daily for four years, I can say that it's more than worth the money.

Comments (English): A true homemaker's review of the Samsung Electronics BESPOKE 6-person countertop dishwasher, purchased with her own money after using it for four years. They say only those who have actually used a dishwasher truly understand its convenience. I've been using this product for over four years, and while reorganizing my new home, I switched from the pink color to the white one. Interestingly, my mother-in-law, mother-in-law, and daughter-in-law all bought new ones after seeing me use it, and they're all very happy with it! Now, I'm buying new ones and recommending it to everyone I know. This dishwasher is truly trustworthy. 1. A homemaker's verdict after four years: I can't live without it. When I first bought it, I was skeptical, wondering, "How useful can this small countertop dishwasher be?" But now, I can honestly say it's the best purchase I've made, next to a washing machine vacuum cleaner. It saves me 30-40 minutes of daily hand-washing time, and best of all, it removes grease and grime much more thoroughly than washing dishes by hand. I have a child, so we handle a lot of dishes, and this product has significantly reduced wrist strain. 2. Why I switched from pink to white. The original pink was beautiful and luxurious, typical of BESPOKE, but the heater malfunctioned, so I moved. With my recent kitchen interior renovation, I thought white would be a better match, so I chose it without hesitation. White is much cleaner, makes the kitchen look more spacious, and goes well with any cabinet tone. Just a color change from the new model completely transformed the kitchen. I only changed the dishwasher, and it feels so much cleaner, so I'm 100% satisfied. 3. Cleaning power: This is the most satisfying aspect of my new dishwasher, which has remained constant for four years. Many dishwasher reviews worry that the small size might compromise cleaning power, but my four years of use have proven otherwise. It cleans dried rice, egg wash, and soup stains perfectly. A greasy frying pan is completely clean on high power. It washes children's plates, bottles, and straw cups without any detergent residue. Glass cups retain a clarity that you can never remove by hand. The glass cups, in particular, are incredibly crisp and clear, incomparable to hand washing. The fine oil film that forms when washing dishes by hand is completely gone, and the cups shine like new. 4. Drying Power: Almost perfect, except for the plastic. After four years of use, I've noticed that the drying power is better than I expected. Ceramics are completely fluffy. Frying pans dry well. Glass cups are almost free of water marks. Plastic sometimes has a few water droplets (a common problem with any dishwasher). However, leaving the door slightly open dries quickly, so it's not a major inconvenience. 5. Noise: I can run it at night. I usually run it at night after putting the kids to bed, and I haven't experienced any noise stress in four years. The sound of the water circulating is faint. It doesn't bother me when watching TV. It's also a plus that it's quiet enough to run at night. 6. Ease of Use: These are the advantages I've noticed from daily use. The simple button controls make it easy for my husband and in-laws to use. The spacious and versatile interior layout makes loading dishes a breeze. It holds 45 rice bowls, 23 soup bowls, plates, and children's plates. Cooking utensils fit easily as long as you adjust the angle. There's no water splashing or leaking (based on 4 years of use). The interior is intuitively wide, not square, making it easy to load. I found this to be much better than other brands. 7. Installation and maintenance are easy even for a single housewife. The first installation wasn't difficult, and I did it myself when I switched to white. Connecting the hose took just a few minutes. Drainage is also easy. Cleaning is easy thanks to the small internal gaps. The filter only needs to be washed once or twice a week. There haven't been any major issues in 4 years. 8. Design: The BESPOKE is truly beautiful. The pink was beautiful, but the white is even prettier. It's simple yet luxurious, and it doesn't have the "space-hogging" feel typical of countertop models. It keeps the kitchen looking organized, and its sophisticated design adds a significant touch to the interior. It's a design that truly pleases every homemaker. Overall Review: A housewife's verdict after using it for four years: a truly self-made purchase. I'm so satisfied that I'd buy it again. No problems in four years. Excellent cleaning power. Satisfactory drying performance. Good noise reduction. The design is top-notch. It improves the quality of life for housewives. In particular, my in-laws, who tried it, bought it right away and are still using it. I think this is the greatest testament to the actual user satisfaction. I liked the pink version, but the white one I bought this time is even neater and perfectly complements the kitchen atmosphere, making me so happy I bought it again. I confidently recommend it to anyone buying a dishwasher for the first time, those considering a small kitchen, or families with children. Having used it daily for four years, I can say that it's more than worth the money.

고급스러웠는데, 히터기능이 고장나서 이사도했고 이번에 주방 인테리어를 바꾸면서 화이트가 더 잘 어울릴 것 같아 고민 없이 화이트로 선택했어요.•화이트는 훨씬 더 깔끔하고•주방이 넓어 보이고•어떤 톤의 상부장/하부장에도 잘 어울리고새 제품이랑 색감만 바뀌었을 뿐인데 주방 분위기가 확 달라졌어요.식기세척기 하나만 바꿨는데 깔끔함이 훨씬 살아나는 느낌이라 만족도 효과도 커요.주부의 눈을 만족시키는 디자인이라는 게 가장 정확해요.⸻ 총평: 4년 써본 주부의 진짜 내돈내산 결론✔ 다시 사라면 또 살 만큼 만족도 높음✔ 4년 동안 고장 없음✔ 세척력 → 뛰어남✔ 건조력 → 만족✔ 소음 → 양호✔ 디자인 → 최고✔ 주부 삶의 질이 올라감특히“이 제품 써본 시댁 아가씨도 바로 사서 지금도 잘 쓰고 있다”는 부분이 실사용자 만족도를 말해주는 가장 큰 증거라고 생각해요.핑크 버전도 좋았지만, 이번에 산 화이트는 더 깔끔하고 주방 분위기를 완전히 살려줘서 재구매하길 너무 잘했다는 생각이 듭니다.식세기 처음 사는 분, 작은 주방이라 고민하는 분, 아이 있는 집 모두에게 자신 있게 추천합니다.4년 동안 매일같이 사용해 본 입장에서 돈값 이상 하는 제품이에요.

Sentence (English): Cooking utensils fit easily as long as you adjust the angle.
Comments (English): A true homemaker's review of the Samsung Electronics BESPOKE 6-person countertop dishwasher, purchased with her own money after using it for four years. They say only those who have actually used a dishwasher truly understand its convenience. I've been using this product for over four years, and while reorganizing my new home, I switched from the pink color to the white one. Interestingly, my mother-in-law, mother-in-law, and daughter-in-law all bought new ones after seeing me use it, and they're all very happy with it! Now, I'm buying new ones and recommending it to everyone I know. This dishwasher is truly trustworthy. 1. A homemaker's verdict after four years: I can't live without it. When I first bought it, I was skeptical, wondering, "How useful can this small countertop dishwasher be?" But now, I can honestly say it's the best purchase I've made, next to a washing machine vacuum cleaner. It saves me 30-40 minutes of daily hand-washing time, and best of all, it removes grease and grime much more thoroughly than washing dishes by hand. I have a child, so we handle a lot of dishes, and this product has significantly reduced wrist strain. 2. Why I switched from pink to white. The original pink was beautiful and luxurious, typical of BESPOKE, but the heater malfunctioned, so I moved. With my recent kitchen interior renovation, I thought white would be a better match, so I chose it without hesitation. White is much cleaner, makes the kitchen look more spacious, and goes well with any cabinet tone. Just a color change from the new model completely transformed the kitchen. I only changed the dishwasher, and it feels so much cleaner, so I'm 100% satisfied. 3. Cleaning power: This is the most satisfying aspect of my new dishwasher, which has remained constant for four years. Many dishwasher reviews worry that the small size might compromise cleaning power, but my four years of use have proven otherwise. It cleans dried rice, egg wash, and soup stains perfectly. A greasy frying pan is completely clean on high power. It washes children's plates, bottles, and straw cups without any detergent residue. Glass cups retain a clarity that you can never remove by hand. The glass cups, in particular, are incredibly crisp and clear, incomparable to hand washing. The fine oil film that forms when washing dishes by hand is completely gone, and the cups shine like new. 4. Drying Power: Almost perfect, except for the plastic. After four years of use, I've noticed that the drying power is better than I expected. Ceramics are completely fluffy. Frying pans dry well. Glass cups are almost free of water marks. Plastic sometimes has a few water droplets (a common problem with any dishwasher). However, leaving the door slightly open dries quickly, so it's not a major inconvenience. 5. Noise: I can run it at night. I usually run it at night after putting the kids to bed, and I haven't experienced any noise stress in four years. The sound of the water circulating is faint. It doesn't bother me when watching TV. It's also a plus that it's quiet enough to run at night. 6. Ease of Use: These are the advantages I've noticed from daily use. The simple button controls make it easy for my husband and in-laws to use. The spacious and versatile interior layout makes loading dishes a breeze. It holds 45 rice bowls, 23 soup bowls, plates, and children's plates. Cooking utensils fit easily as long as you adjust the angle. There's no water splashing or leaking (based on 4 years of use). The interior is intuitively wide, not square, making it easy to load. I found this to be much better than other brands. 7. Installation and maintenance are easy even for a single housewife. The first installation wasn't difficult, and I did it myself when I switched to white. Connecting the hose took just a few minutes. Drainage is also easy. Cleaning is easy thanks to the small internal gaps. The filter only needs to be washed once or twice a week. There haven't been any major issues in 4 years. 8. Design: The BESPOKE is truly beautiful. The pink was beautiful, but the white is even prettier. It's simple yet luxurious, and it doesn't have the "space-hogging" feel typical of countertop models. It keeps the kitchen looking organized, and its sophisticated design adds a significant touch to the interior. It's a design that truly pleases every homemaker. Overall Review: A housewife's verdict after using it for four years: a truly self-made purchase. I'm so satisfied that I'd buy it again. No problems in four years. Excellent cleaning power. Satisfactory drying performance. Good noise reduction. The design is top-notch. It improves the quality of life for housewives. In particular, my in-laws, who tried it, bought it right away and are still using it. I think this is the greatest testament to the actual user satisfaction. I liked the pink version, but the white one I bought this time is even neater and perfectly complements the kitchen atmosphere, making me so happy I bought it again. I confidently recommend it to anyone buying a dishwasher for the first time, those considering a small kitchen, or families with children. Having used it daily for four years, I can say that it's more than worth the money.

고급스러웠는데, 히터기능이 고장나서 이사도했고 이번에 주방 인테리어를 바꾸면서 화이트가 더 잘 어울릴 것 같아 고민 없이 화이트로 선택했어요.•화이트는 훨씬 더 깔끔하고•주방이 넓어 보이고•어떤 톤의 상부장/하부장에도 잘 어울리고새 제품이랑 색감만 바뀌었을 뿐인데 주방 분위기가 확 달라졌어요.식기세척기 하나만 바꿨는데 깔끔함이 훨씬 살아나는 느낌이라 만족도 수월하게 들어감✔ 외부 물 튀는 일 없고 물 새는 일 전혀 없음 (4년 사용 기준)특히 내부가 ㄹ자 구조가 아니라 직관적으로 넓게 뻗은 구조라서 넣기가 쉬워요.이 부분은 다른 브랜드보다 훨씬 좋다고 느꼈습니다.⸻ 7. 설치, 관리 – 주부 혼자서도 가능처음 설치할 때도 어렵지 않았고, 이번에 화이트로 바꿀 때도 제가 혼자 설치했어요.•호스 연결 → 몇 효과도 커요.주부의 눈을 만족시키는 디자인이라는 게 가장 정확해요.⸻ 총평: 4년 써본 주부의 진짜 내돈내산 결론✔ 다시 사라면 또 살 만큼 만족도 높음✔ 4년 동안 고장 없음✔ 세척력 → 뛰어남✔ 건조력 → 만족✔ 소음 → 양호✔ 디자인 → 최고✔ 주부 삶의 질이 올라감특히“이 제품 써본 시댁 아가씨도 바로 사서 지금도 잘 쓰고 있다”는 부분이 실사용자 만족도를 말해주는 가장 큰 증거라고 생각해요.핑크 버전도 좋았지만, 이번에 산 화이트는 더 깔끔하고 주방 분위기를 완전히 살려줘서 재구매하길 너무 잘했다는 생각이 듭니다.식세기 처음 사는 분, 작은 주방이라 고민하는 분, 아이 있는 집 모두에게 자신 있게 추천합니다.4년 동안 매일같이 사용해 본 입장에서 돈값 이상 하는 제품이에요.

Comments (English): A true homemaker's review of the Samsung Electronics BESPOKE 6-person countertop dishwasher, purchased with her own money after using it for four years. They say only those who have actually used a dishwasher truly understand its convenience. I've been using this product for over four years, and while reorganizing my new home, I switched from the pink color to the white one. Interestingly, my mother-in-law, mother-in-law, and daughter-in-law all bought new ones after seeing me use it, and they're all very happy with it! Now, I'm buying new ones and recommending it to everyone I know. This dishwasher is truly trustworthy. 1. A homemaker's verdict after four years: I can't live without it. When I first bought it, I was skeptical, wondering, "How useful can this small countertop dishwasher be?" But now, I can honestly say it's the best purchase I've made, next to a washing machine vacuum cleaner. It saves me 30-40 minutes of daily hand-washing time, and best of all, it removes grease and grime much more thoroughly than washing dishes by hand. I have a child, so we handle a lot of dishes, and this product has significantly reduced wrist strain. 2. Why I switched from pink to white. The original pink was beautiful and luxurious, typical of BESPOKE, but the heater malfunctioned, so I moved. With my recent kitchen interior renovation, I thought white would be a better match, so I chose it without hesitation. White is much cleaner, makes the kitchen look more spacious, and goes well with any cabinet tone. Just a color change from the new model completely transformed the kitchen. I only changed the dishwasher, and it feels so much cleaner, so I'm 100% satisfied. 3. Cleaning power: This is the most satisfying aspect of my new dishwasher, which has remained constant for four years. Many dishwasher reviews worry that the small size might compromise cleaning power, but my four years of use have proven otherwise. It cleans dried rice, egg wash, and soup stains perfectly. A greasy frying pan is completely clean on high power. It washes children's plates, bottles, and straw cups without any detergent residue. Glass cups retain a clarity that you can never remove by hand. The glass cups, in particular, are incredibly crisp and clear, incomparable to hand washing. The fine oil film that forms when washing dishes by hand is completely gone, and the cups shine like new. 4. Drying Power: Almost perfect, except for the plastic. After four years of use, I've noticed that the drying power is better than I expected. Ceramics are completely fluffy. Frying pans dry well. Glass cups are almost free of water marks. Plastic sometimes has a few water droplets (a common problem with any dishwasher). However, leaving the door slightly open dries quickly, so it's not a major inconvenience. 5. Noise: I can run it at night. I usually run it at night after putting the kids to bed, and I haven't experienced any noise stress in four years. The sound of the water circulating is faint. It doesn't bother me when watching TV. It's also a plus that it's quiet enough to run at night. 6. Ease of Use: These are the advantages I've noticed from daily use. The simple button controls make it easy for my husband and in-laws to use. The spacious and versatile interior layout makes loading dishes a breeze. It holds 45 rice bowls, 23 soup bowls, plates, and children's plates. Cooking utensils fit easily as long as you adjust the angle. There's no water splashing or leaking (based on 4 years of use). The interior is intuitively wide, not square, making it easy to load. I found this to be much better than other brands. 7. Installation and maintenance are easy even for a single housewife. The first installation wasn't difficult, and I did it myself when I switched to white. Connecting the hose took just a few minutes. Drainage is also easy. Cleaning is easy thanks to the small internal gaps. The filter only needs to be washed once or twice a week. There haven't been any major issues in 4 years. 8. Design: The BESPOKE is truly beautiful. The pink was beautiful, but the white is even prettier. It's simple yet luxurious, and it doesn't have the "space-hogging" feel typical of countertop models. It keeps the kitchen looking organized, and its sophisticated design adds a significant touch to the interior. It's a design that truly pleases every homemaker. Overall Review: A housewife's verdict after using it for four years: a truly self-made purchase. I'm so satisfied that I'd buy it again. No problems in four years. Excellent cleaning power. Satisfactory drying performance. Good noise reduction. The design is top-notch. It improves the quality of life for housewives. In particular, my in-laws, who tried it, bought it right away and are still using it. I think this is the greatest testament to the actual user satisfaction. I liked the pink version, but the white one I bought this time is even neater and perfectly complements the kitchen atmosphere, making me so happy I bought it again. I confidently recommend it to anyone buying a dishwasher for the first time, those considering a small kitchen, or families with children. Having used it daily for four years, I can say that it's more than worth the money.

Comments (English): A true homemaker's review of the Samsung Electronics BESPOKE 6-person countertop dishwasher, purchased with her own money after using it for four years. They say only those who have actually used a dishwasher truly understand its convenience. I've been using this product for over four years, and while reorganizing my new home, I switched from the pink color to the white one. Interestingly, my mother-in-law, mother-in-law, and daughter-in-law all bought new ones after seeing me use it, and they're all very happy with it! Now, I'm buying new ones and recommending it to everyone I know. This dishwasher is truly trustworthy. 1. A homemaker's verdict after four years: I can't live without it. When I first bought it, I was skeptical, wondering, "How useful can this small countertop dishwasher be?" But now, I can honestly say it's the best purchase I've made, next to a washing machine vacuum cleaner. It saves me 30-40 minutes of daily hand-washing time, and best of all, it removes grease and grime much more thoroughly than washing dishes by hand. I have a child, so we handle a lot of dishes, and this product has significantly reduced wrist strain. 2. Why I switched from pink to white. The original pink was beautiful and luxurious, typical of BESPOKE, but the heater malfunctioned, so I moved. With my recent kitchen interior renovation, I thought white would be a better match, so I chose it without hesitation. White is much cleaner, makes the kitchen look more spacious, and goes well with any cabinet tone. Just a color change from the new model completely transformed the kitchen. I only changed the dishwasher, and it feels so much cleaner, so I'm 100% satisfied. 3. Cleaning power: This is the most satisfying aspect of my new dishwasher, which has remained constant for four years. Many dishwasher reviews worry that the small size might compromise cleaning power, but my four years of use have proven otherwise. It cleans dried rice, egg wash, and soup stains perfectly. A greasy frying pan is completely clean on high power. It washes children's plates, bottles, and straw cups without any detergent residue. Glass cups retain a clarity that you can never remove by hand. The glass cups, in particular, are incredibly crisp and clear, incomparable to hand washing. The fine oil film that forms when washing dishes by hand is completely gone, and the cups shine like new. 4. Drying Power: Almost perfect, except for the plastic. After four years of use, I've noticed that the drying power is better than I expected. Ceramics are completely fluffy. Frying pans dry well. Glass cups are almost free of water marks. Plastic sometimes has a few water droplets (a common problem with any dishwasher). However, leaving the door slightly open dries quickly, so it's not a major inconvenience. 5. Noise: I can run it at night. I usually run it at night after putting the kids to bed, and I haven't experienced any noise stress in four years. The sound of the water circulating is faint. It doesn't bother me when watching TV. It's also a plus that it's quiet enough to run at night. 6. Ease of Use: These are the advantages I've noticed from daily use. The simple button controls make it easy for my husband and in-laws to use. The spacious and versatile interior layout makes loading dishes a breeze. It holds 45 rice bowls, 23 soup bowls, plates, and children's plates. Cooking utensils fit easily as long as you adjust the angle. There's no water splashing or leaking (based on 4 years of use). The interior is intuitively wide, not square, making it easy to load. I found this to be much better than other brands. 7. Installation and maintenance are easy even for a single housewife. The first installation wasn't difficult, and I did it myself when I switched to white. Connecting the hose took just a few minutes. Drainage is also easy. Cleaning is easy thanks to the small internal gaps. The filter only needs to be washed once or twice a week. There haven't been any major issues in 4 years. 8. Design: The BESPOKE is truly beautiful. The pink was beautiful, but the white is even prettier. It's simple yet luxurious, and it doesn't have the "space-hogging" feel typical of countertop models. It keeps the kitchen looking organized, and its sophisticated design adds a significant touch to the interior. It's a design that truly pleases every homemaker. Overall Review: A housewife's verdict after using it for four years: a truly self-made purchase. I'm so satisfied that I'd buy it again. No problems in four years. Excellent cleaning power. Satisfactory drying performance. Good noise reduction. The design is top-notch. It improves the quality of life for housewives. In particular, my in-laws, who tried it, bought it right away and are still using it. I think this is the greatest testament to the actual user satisfaction. I liked the pink version, but the white one I bought this time is even neater and perfectly complements the kitchen atmosphere, making me so happy I bought it again. I confidently recommend it to anyone buying a dishwasher for the first time, those considering a small kitchen, or families with children. Having used it daily for four years, I can say that it's more than worth the money.

고급스러웠는데, 히터기능이 고장나서 이사도했고 이번에 주방 인테리어를 바꾸면서 화이트가 더 잘 어울릴 것 같아 고민 없이 화이트로 선택했어요.•화이트는 훨씬 더 깔끔하고•주방이 넓어 보이고•어떤 톤의 상부장/하부장에도 잘 어울리고새 제품이랑 색감만 바뀌었을 뿐인데 주방 분위기가 확 달라졌어요.식기세척기 하나만 바꿨는데 깔끔함이 훨씬 살아나는 느낌이라 만족도 들리는 정도•TV 볼 때도 신경 안 쓰임•아파트에서도 전혀 문제 없음밤 돌리기 부담 없는 소음 수준이라 이것도 장점.⸻ 6. 사용 편의성 – 주부가 매일 쓰면서 느낀 장점들✔ 버튼 조작이 단순해서 남편, 시부모님도 쉽게 사용✔ 내부 배치가 넓고 다양해서 식기 넣기 편함✔ 밥그릇 45개, 국그릇 23개, 접시, 아이식판 다 들어감✔ 조리도구도 각도만 맞추면 분이면 끝•배수도 편함•청소도 내부 틈이 적어서 관리 쉬움•필터는 주 1~2회만 씻어주면 OK4년 동안 특별한 고장 1도 없었습니다.⸻ 8. 디자인 – BESPOKE 진짜 예쁨핑크도 예뻤지만 화이트는 정말 더 예뻐요.심플하면서 고급스럽고, 특히 카운터탑 타입 특유의 ‘공간 차지하는 느낌’이 거의 없습니다.주방이 정돈돼 보이고, 세련된 분위기라 인테리어 효과도 커요.주부의 눈을 만족시키는 디자인이라는 게 가장 정확해요.⸻ 총평: 4년 써본 주부의 진짜 내돈내산 결론✔ 다시 사라면 또 살 만큼 만족도 높음✔ 4년 동안 고장 없음✔ 세척력 → 뛰어남✔ 건조력 → 만족✔ 소음 → 양호✔ 디자인 → 최고✔ 주부 삶의 질이 올라감특히“이 제품 써본 시댁 아가씨도 바로 사서 지금도 잘 쓰고 있다”는 부분이 실사용자 만족도를 말해주는 가장 큰 증거라고 생각해요.핑크 버전도 좋았지만, 이번에 산 화이트는 더 깔끔하고 주방 분위기를 완전히 살려줘서 재구매하길 너무 잘했다는 생각이 듭니다.식세기 처음 사는 분, 작은 주방이라 고민하는 분, 아이 있는 집 모두에게 자신 있게 추천합니다.4년 동안 매일같이 사용해 본 입장에서 돈값 이상 하는 제품이에요.

Sentence (English): Installation and maintenance are easy even for a single housewife.
Comments (English): A true homemaker's review of the Samsung Electronics BESPOKE 6-person countertop dishwasher, purchased with her own money after using it for four years. They say only those who have actually used a dishwasher truly understand its convenience. I've been using this product for over four years, and while reorganizing my new home, I switched from the pink color to the white one. Interestingly, my mother-in-law, mother-in-law, and daughter-in-law all bought new ones after seeing me use it, and they're all very happy with it! Now, I'm buying new ones and recommending it to everyone I know. This dishwasher is truly trustworthy. 1. A homemaker's verdict after four years: I can't live without it. When I first bought it, I was skeptical, wondering, "How useful can this small countertop dishwasher be?" But now, I can honestly say it's the best purchase I've made, next to a washing machine vacuum cleaner. It saves me 30-40 minutes of daily hand-washing time, and best of all, it removes grease and grime much more thoroughly than washing dishes by hand. I have a child, so we handle a lot of dishes, and this product has significantly reduced wrist strain. 2. Why I switched from pink to white. The original pink was beautiful and luxurious, typical of BESPOKE, but the heater malfunctioned, so I moved. With my recent kitchen interior renovation, I thought white would be a better match, so I chose it without hesitation. White is much cleaner, makes the kitchen look more spacious, and goes well with any cabinet tone. Just a color change from the new model completely transformed the kitchen. I only changed the dishwasher, and it feels so much cleaner, so I'm 100% satisfied. 3. Cleaning power: This is the most satisfying aspect of my new dishwasher, which has remained constant for four years. Many dishwasher reviews worry that the small size might compromise cleaning power, but my four years of use have proven otherwise. It cleans dried rice, egg wash, and soup stains perfectly. A greasy frying pan is completely clean on high power. It washes children's plates, bottles, and straw cups without any detergent residue. Glass cups retain a clarity that you can never remove by hand. The glass cups, in particular, are incredibly crisp and clear, incomparable to hand washing. The fine oil film that forms when washing dishes by hand is completely gone, and the cups shine like new. 4. Drying Power: Almost perfect, except for the plastic. After four years of use, I've noticed that the drying power is better than I expected. Ceramics are completely fluffy. Frying pans dry well. Glass cups are almost free of water marks. Plastic sometimes has a few water droplets (a common problem with any dishwasher). However, leaving the door slightly open dries quickly, so it's not a major inconvenience. 5. Noise: I can run it at night. I usually run it at night after putting the kids to bed, and I haven't experienced any noise stress in four years. The sound of the water circulating is faint. It doesn't bother me when watching TV. It's also a plus that it's quiet enough to run at night. 6. Ease of Use: These are the advantages I've noticed from daily use. The simple button controls make it easy for my husband and in-laws to use. The spacious and versatile interior layout makes loading dishes a breeze. It holds 45 rice bowls, 23 soup bowls, plates, and children's plates. Cooking utensils fit easily as long as you adjust the angle. There's no water splashing or leaking (based on 4 years of use). The interior is intuitively wide, not square, making it easy to load. I found this to be much better than other brands. 7. Installation and maintenance are easy even for a single housewife. The first installation wasn't difficult, and I did it myself when I switched to white. Connecting the hose took just a few minutes. Drainage is also easy. Cleaning is easy thanks to the small internal gaps. The filter only needs to be washed once or twice a week. There haven't been any major issues in 4 years. 8. Design: The BESPOKE is truly beautiful. The pink was beautiful, but the white is even prettier. It's simple yet luxurious, and it doesn't have the "space-hogging" feel typical of countertop models. It keeps the kitchen looking organized, and its sophisticated design adds a significant touch to the interior. It's a design that truly pleases every homemaker. Overall Review: A housewife's verdict after using it for four years: a truly self-made purchase. I'm so satisfied that I'd buy it again. No problems in four years. Excellent cleaning power. Satisfactory drying performance. Good noise reduction. The design is top-notch. It improves the quality of life for housewives. In particular, my in-laws, who tried it, bought it right away and are still using it. I think this is the greatest testament to the actual user satisfaction. I liked the pink version, but the white one I bought this time is even neater and perfectly complements the kitchen atmosphere, making me so happy I bought it again. I confidently recommend it to anyone buying a dishwasher for the first time, those considering a small kitchen, or families with children. Having used it daily for four years, I can say that it's more than worth the money.

Comments (English): A true homemaker's review of the Samsung Electronics BESPOKE 6-person countertop dishwasher, purchased with her own money after using it for four years. They say only those who have actually used a dishwasher truly understand its convenience. I've been using this product for over four years, and while reorganizing my new home, I switched from the pink color to the white one. Interestingly, my mother-in-law, mother-in-law, and daughter-in-law all bought new ones after seeing me use it, and they're all very happy with it! Now, I'm buying new ones and recommending it to everyone I know. This dishwasher is truly trustworthy. 1. A homemaker's verdict after four years: I can't live without it. When I first bought it, I was skeptical, wondering, "How useful can this small countertop dishwasher be?" But now, I can honestly say it's the best purchase I've made, next to a washing machine vacuum cleaner. It saves me 30-40 minutes of daily hand-washing time, and best of all, it removes grease and grime much more thoroughly than washing dishes by hand. I have a child, so we handle a lot of dishes, and this product has significantly reduced wrist strain. 2. Why I switched from pink to white. The original pink was beautiful and luxurious, typical of BESPOKE, but the heater malfunctioned, so I moved. With my recent kitchen interior renovation, I thought white would be a better match, so I chose it without hesitation. White is much cleaner, makes the kitchen look more spacious, and goes well with any cabinet tone. Just a color change from the new model completely transformed the kitchen. I only changed the dishwasher, and it feels so much cleaner, so I'm 100% satisfied. 3. Cleaning power: This is the most satisfying aspect of my new dishwasher, which has remained constant for four years. Many dishwasher reviews worry that the small size might compromise cleaning power, but my four years of use have proven otherwise. It cleans dried rice, egg wash, and soup stains perfectly. A greasy frying pan is completely clean on high power. It washes children's plates, bottles, and straw cups without any detergent residue. Glass cups retain a clarity that you can never remove by hand. The glass cups, in particular, are incredibly crisp and clear, incomparable to hand washing. The fine oil film that forms when washing dishes by hand is completely gone, and the cups shine like new. 4. Drying Power: Almost perfect, except for the plastic. After four years of use, I've noticed that the drying power is better than I expected. Ceramics are completely fluffy. Frying pans dry well. Glass cups are almost free of water marks. Plastic sometimes has a few water droplets (a common problem with any dishwasher). However, leaving the door slightly open dries quickly, so it's not a major inconvenience. 5. Noise: I can run it at night. I usually run it at night after putting the kids to bed, and I haven't experienced any noise stress in four years. The sound of the water circulating is faint. It doesn't bother me when watching TV. It's also a plus that it's quiet enough to run at night. 6. Ease of Use: These are the advantages I've noticed from daily use. The simple button controls make it easy for my husband and in-laws to use. The spacious and versatile interior layout makes loading dishes a breeze. It holds 45 rice bowls, 23 soup bowls, plates, and children's plates. Cooking utensils fit easily as long as you adjust the angle. There's no water splashing or leaking (based on 4 years of use). The interior is intuitively wide, not square, making it easy to load. I found this to be much better than other brands. 7. Installation and maintenance are easy even for a single housewife. The first installation wasn't difficult, and I did it myself when I switched to white. Connecting the hose took just a few minutes. Drainage is also easy. Cleaning is easy thanks to the small internal gaps. The filter only needs to be washed once or twice a week. There haven't been any major issues in 4 years. 8. Design: The BESPOKE is truly beautiful. The pink was beautiful, but the white is even prettier. It's simple yet luxurious, and it doesn't have the "space-hogging" feel typical of countertop models. It keeps the kitchen looking organized, and its sophisticated design adds a significant touch to the interior. It's a design that truly pleases every homemaker. Overall Review: A housewife's verdict after using it for four years: a truly self-made purchase. I'm so satisfied that I'd buy it again. No problems in four years. Excellent cleaning power. Satisfactory drying performance. Good noise reduction. The design is top-notch. It improves the quality of life for housewives. In particular, my in-laws, who tried it, bought it right away and are still using it. I think this is the greatest testament to the actual user satisfaction. I liked the pink version, but the white one I bought this time is even neater and perfectly complements the kitchen atmosphere, making me so happy I bought it again. I confidently recommend it to anyone buying a dishwasher for the first time, those considering a small kitchen, or families with children. Having used it daily for four years, I can say that it's more than worth the money.

Sentence (English): There haven't been any major issues in 4 years.
Comments (English): A true homemaker's review of the Samsung Electronics BESPOKE 6-person countertop dishwasher, purchased with her own money after using it for four years. They say only those who have actually used a dishwasher truly understand its convenience. I've been using this product for over four years, and while reorganizing my new home, I switched from the pink color to the white one. Interestingly, my mother-in-law, mother-in-law, and daughter-in-law all bought new ones after seeing me use it, and they're all very happy with it! Now, I'm buying new ones and recommending it to everyone I know. This dishwasher is truly trustworthy. 1. A homemaker's verdict after four years: I can't live without it. When I first bought it, I was skeptical, wondering, "How useful can this small countertop dishwasher be?" But now, I can honestly say it's the best purchase I've made, next to a washing machine vacuum cleaner. It saves me 30-40 minutes of daily hand-washing time, and best of all, it removes grease and grime much more thoroughly than washing dishes by hand. I have a child, so we handle a lot of dishes, and this product has significantly reduced wrist strain. 2. Why I switched from pink to white. The original pink was beautiful and luxurious, typical of BESPOKE, but the heater malfunctioned, so I moved. With my recent kitchen interior renovation, I thought white would be a better match, so I chose it without hesitation. White is much cleaner, makes the kitchen look more spacious, and goes well with any cabinet tone. Just a color change from the new model completely transformed the kitchen. I only changed the dishwasher, and it feels so much cleaner, so I'm 100% satisfied. 3. Cleaning power: This is the most satisfying aspect of my new dishwasher, which has remained constant for four years. Many dishwasher reviews worry that the small size might compromise cleaning power, but my four years of use have proven otherwise. It cleans dried rice, egg wash, and soup stains perfectly. A greasy frying pan is completely clean on high power. It washes children's plates, bottles, and straw cups without any detergent residue. Glass cups retain a clarity that you can never remove by hand. The glass cups, in particular, are incredibly crisp and clear, incomparable to hand washing. The fine oil film that forms when washing dishes by hand is completely gone, and the cups shine like new. 4. Drying Power: Almost perfect, except for the plastic. After four years of use, I've noticed that the drying power is better than I expected. Ceramics are completely fluffy. Frying pans dry well. Glass cups are almost free of water marks. Plastic sometimes has a few water droplets (a common problem with any dishwasher). However, leaving the door slightly open dries quickly, so it's not a major inconvenience. 5. Noise: I can run it at night. I usually run it at night after putting the kids to bed, and I haven't experienced any noise stress in four years. The sound of the water circulating is faint. It doesn't bother me when watching TV. It's also a plus that it's quiet enough to run at night. 6. Ease of Use: These are the advantages I've noticed from daily use. The simple button controls make it easy for my husband and in-laws to use. The spacious and versatile interior layout makes loading dishes a breeze. It holds 45 rice bowls, 23 soup bowls, plates, and children's plates. Cooking utensils fit easily as long as you adjust the angle. There's no water splashing or leaking (based on 4 years of use). The interior is intuitively wide, not square, making it easy to load. I found this to be much better than other brands. 7. Installation and maintenance are easy even for a single housewife. The first installation wasn't difficult, and I did it myself when I switched to white. Connecting the hose took just a few minutes. Drainage is also easy. Cleaning is easy thanks to the small internal gaps. The filter only needs to be washed once or twice a week. There haven't been any major issues in 4 years. 8. Design: The BESPOKE is truly beautiful. The pink was beautiful, but the white is even prettier. It's simple yet luxurious, and it doesn't have the "space-hogging" feel typical of countertop models. It keeps the kitchen looking organized, and its sophisticated design adds a significant touch to the interior. It's a design that truly pleases every homemaker. Overall Review: A housewife's verdict after using it for four years: a truly self-made purchase. I'm so satisfied that I'd buy it again. No problems in four years. Excellent cleaning power. Satisfactory drying performance. Good noise reduction. The design is top-notch. It improves the quality of life for housewives. In particular, my in-laws, who tried it, bought it right away and are still using it. I think this is the greatest testament to the actual user satisfaction. I liked the pink version, but the white one I bought this time is even neater and perfectly complements the kitchen atmosphere, making me so happy I bought it again. I confidently recommend it to anyone buying a dishwasher for the first time, those considering a small kitchen, or families with children. Having used it daily for four years, I can say that it's more than worth the money.
