Sentence (English): The pink was beautiful, but the white is even prettier.
Comments (English): A true homemaker's review of the Samsung Electronics BESPOKE 6-person countertop dishwasher, purchased with her own money after using it for four years. They say only those who have actually used a dishwasher truly understand its convenience. I've been using this product for over four years, and while reorganizing my new home, I switched from the pink color to the white one. Interestingly, my mother-in-law, mother-in-law, and daughter-in-law all bought new ones after seeing me use it, and they're all very happy with it! Now, I'm buying new ones and recommending it to everyone I know. This dishwasher is truly trustworthy. 1. A homemaker's verdict after four years: I can't live without it. When I first bought it, I was skeptical, wondering, "How useful can this small countertop dishwasher be?" But now, I can honestly say it's the best purchase I've made, next to a washing machine vacuum cleaner. It saves me 30-40 minutes of daily hand-washing time, and best of all, it removes grease and grime much more thoroughly than washing dishes by hand. I have a child, so we handle a lot of dishes, and this product has significantly reduced wrist strain. 2. Why I switched from pink to white. The original pink was beautiful and luxurious, typical of BESPOKE, but the heater malfunctioned, so I moved. With my recent kitchen interior renovation, I thought white would be a better match, so I chose it without hesitation. White is much cleaner, makes the kitchen look more spacious, and goes well with any cabinet tone. Just a color change from the new model completely transformed the kitchen. I only changed the dishwasher, and it feels so much cleaner, so I'm 100% satisfied. 3. Cleaning power: This is the most satisfying aspect of my new dishwasher, which has remained constant for four years. Many dishwasher reviews worry that the small size might compromise cleaning power, but my four years of use have proven otherwise. It cleans dried rice, egg wash, and soup stains perfectly. A greasy frying pan is completely clean on high power. It washes children's plates, bottles, and straw cups without any detergent residue. Glass cups retain a clarity that you can never remove by hand. The glass cups, in particular, are incredibly crisp and clear, incomparable to hand washing. The fine oil film that forms when washing dishes by hand is completely gone, and the cups shine like new. 4. Drying Power: Almost perfect, except for the plastic. After four years of use, I've noticed that the drying power is better than I expected. Ceramics are completely fluffy. Frying pans dry well. Glass cups are almost free of water marks. Plastic sometimes has a few water droplets (a common problem with any dishwasher). However, leaving the door slightly open dries quickly, so it's not a major inconvenience. 5. Noise: I can run it at night. I usually run it at night after putting the kids to bed, and I haven't experienced any noise stress in four years. The sound of the water circulating is faint. It doesn't bother me when watching TV. It's also a plus that it's quiet enough to run at night. 6. Ease of Use: These are the advantages I've noticed from daily use. The simple button controls make it easy for my husband and in-laws to use. The spacious and versatile interior layout makes loading dishes a breeze. It holds 45 rice bowls, 23 soup bowls, plates, and children's plates. Cooking utensils fit easily as long as you adjust the angle. There's no water splashing or leaking (based on 4 years of use). The interior is intuitively wide, not square, making it easy to load. I found this to be much better than other brands. 7. Installation and maintenance are easy even for a single housewife. The first installation wasn't difficult, and I did it myself when I switched to white. Connecting the hose took just a few minutes. Drainage is also easy. Cleaning is easy thanks to the small internal gaps. The filter only needs to be washed once or twice a week. There haven't been any major issues in 4 years. 8. Design: The BESPOKE is truly beautiful. The pink was beautiful, but the white is even prettier. It's simple yet luxurious, and it doesn't have the "space-hogging" feel typical of countertop models. It keeps the kitchen looking organized, and its sophisticated design adds a significant touch to the interior. It's a design that truly pleases every homemaker. Overall Review: A housewife's verdict after using it for four years: a truly self-made purchase. I'm so satisfied that I'd buy it again. No problems in four years. Excellent cleaning power. Satisfactory drying performance. Good noise reduction. The design is top-notch. It improves the quality of life for housewives. In particular, my in-laws, who tried it, bought it right away and are still using it. I think this is the greatest testament to the actual user satisfaction. I liked the pink version, but the white one I bought this time is even neater and perfectly complements the kitchen atmosphere, making me so happy I bought it again. I confidently recommend it to anyone buying a dishwasher for the first time, those considering a small kitchen, or families with children. Having used it daily for four years, I can say that it's more than worth the money.

Sentence (English): It keeps the kitchen looking organized, and its sophisticated design adds a significant touch to the interior.
Comments (English): A true homemaker's review of the Samsung Electronics BESPOKE 6-person countertop dishwasher, purchased with her own money after using it for four years. They say only those who have actually used a dishwasher truly understand its convenience. I've been using this product for over four years, and while reorganizing my new home, I switched from the pink color to the white one. Interestingly, my mother-in-law, mother-in-law, and daughter-in-law all bought new ones after seeing me use it, and they're all very happy with it! Now, I'm buying new ones and recommending it to everyone I know. This dishwasher is truly trustworthy. 1. A homemaker's verdict after four years: I can't live without it. When I first bought it, I was skeptical, wondering, "How useful can this small countertop dishwasher be?" But now, I can honestly say it's the best purchase I've made, next to a washing machine vacuum cleaner. It saves me 30-40 minutes of daily hand-washing time, and best of all, it removes grease and grime much more thoroughly than washing dishes by hand. I have a child, so we handle a lot of dishes, and this product has significantly reduced wrist strain. 2. Why I switched from pink to white. The original pink was beautiful and luxurious, typical of BESPOKE, but the heater malfunctioned, so I moved. With my recent kitchen interior renovation, I thought white would be a better match, so I chose it without hesitation. White is much cleaner, makes the kitchen look more spacious, and goes well with any cabinet tone. Just a color change from the new model completely transformed the kitchen. I only changed the dishwasher, and it feels so much cleaner, so I'm 100% satisfied. 3. Cleaning power: This is the most satisfying aspect of my new dishwasher, which has remained constant for four years. Many dishwasher reviews worry that the small size might compromise cleaning power, but my four years of use have proven otherwise. It cleans dried rice, egg wash, and soup stains perfectly. A greasy frying pan is completely clean on high power. It washes children's plates, bottles, and straw cups without any detergent residue. Glass cups retain a clarity that you can never remove by hand. The glass cups, in particular, are incredibly crisp and clear, incomparable to hand washing. The fine oil film that forms when washing dishes by hand is completely gone, and the cups shine like new. 4. Drying Power: Almost perfect, except for the plastic. After four years of use, I've noticed that the drying power is better than I expected. Ceramics are completely fluffy. Frying pans dry well. Glass cups are almost free of water marks. Plastic sometimes has a few water droplets (a common problem with any dishwasher). However, leaving the door slightly open dries quickly, so it's not a major inconvenience. 5. Noise: I can run it at night. I usually run it at night after putting the kids to bed, and I haven't experienced any noise stress in four years. The sound of the water circulating is faint. It doesn't bother me when watching TV. It's also a plus that it's quiet enough to run at night. 6. Ease of Use: These are the advantages I've noticed from daily use. The simple button controls make it easy for my husband and in-laws to use. The spacious and versatile interior layout makes loading dishes a breeze. It holds 45 rice bowls, 23 soup bowls, plates, and children's plates. Cooking utensils fit easily as long as you adjust the angle. There's no water splashing or leaking (based on 4 years of use). The interior is intuitively wide, not square, making it easy to load. I found this to be much better than other brands. 7. Installation and maintenance are easy even for a single housewife. The first installation wasn't difficult, and I did it myself when I switched to white. Connecting the hose took just a few minutes. Drainage is also easy. Cleaning is easy thanks to the small internal gaps. The filter only needs to be washed once or twice a week. There haven't been any major issues in 4 years. 8. Design: The BESPOKE is truly beautiful. The pink was beautiful, but the white is even prettier. It's simple yet luxurious, and it doesn't have the "space-hogging" feel typical of countertop models. It keeps the kitchen looking organized, and its sophisticated design adds a significant touch to the interior. It's a design that truly pleases every homemaker. Overall Review: A housewife's verdict after using it for four years: a truly self-made purchase. I'm so satisfied that I'd buy it again. No problems in four years. Excellent cleaning power. Satisfactory drying performance. Good noise reduction. The design is top-notch. It improves the quality of life for housewives. In particular, my in-laws, who tried it, bought it right away and are still using it. I think this is the greatest testament to the actual user satisfaction. I liked the pink version, but the white one I bought this time is even neater and perfectly complements the kitchen atmosphere, making me so happy I bought it again. I confidently recommend it to anyone buying a dishwasher for the first time, those considering a small kitchen, or families with children. Having used it daily for four years, I can say that it's more than worth the money.

Sentence (English): I'm so satisfied that I'd buy it again.
Comments (English): A true homemaker's review of the Samsung Electronics BESPOKE 6-person countertop dishwasher, purchased with her own money after using it for four years. They say only those who have actually used a dishwasher truly understand its convenience. I've been using this product for over four years, and while reorganizing my new home, I switched from the pink color to the white one. Interestingly, my mother-in-law, mother-in-law, and daughter-in-law all bought new ones after seeing me use it, and they're all very happy with it! Now, I'm buying new ones and recommending it to everyone I know. This dishwasher is truly trustworthy. 1. A homemaker's verdict after four years: I can't live without it. When I first bought it, I was skeptical, wondering, "How useful can this small countertop dishwasher be?" But now, I can honestly say it's the best purchase I've made, next to a washing machine vacuum cleaner. It saves me 30-40 minutes of daily hand-washing time, and best of all, it removes grease and grime much more thoroughly than washing dishes by hand. I have a child, so we handle a lot of dishes, and this product has significantly reduced wrist strain. 2. Why I switched from pink to white. The original pink was beautiful and luxurious, typical of BESPOKE, but the heater malfunctioned, so I moved. With my recent kitchen interior renovation, I thought white would be a better match, so I chose it without hesitation. White is much cleaner, makes the kitchen look more spacious, and goes well with any cabinet tone. Just a color change from the new model completely transformed the kitchen. I only changed the dishwasher, and it feels so much cleaner, so I'm 100% satisfied. 3. Cleaning power: This is the most satisfying aspect of my new dishwasher, which has remained constant for four years. Many dishwasher reviews worry that the small size might compromise cleaning power, but my four years of use have proven otherwise. It cleans dried rice, egg wash, and soup stains perfectly. A greasy frying pan is completely clean on high power. It washes children's plates, bottles, and straw cups without any detergent residue. Glass cups retain a clarity that you can never remove by hand. The glass cups, in particular, are incredibly crisp and clear, incomparable to hand washing. The fine oil film that forms when washing dishes by hand is completely gone, and the cups shine like new. 4. Drying Power: Almost perfect, except for the plastic. After four years of use, I've noticed that the drying power is better than I expected. Ceramics are completely fluffy. Frying pans dry well. Glass cups are almost free of water marks. Plastic sometimes has a few water droplets (a common problem with any dishwasher). However, leaving the door slightly open dries quickly, so it's not a major inconvenience. 5. Noise: I can run it at night. I usually run it at night after putting the kids to bed, and I haven't experienced any noise stress in four years. The sound of the water circulating is faint. It doesn't bother me when watching TV. It's also a plus that it's quiet enough to run at night. 6. Ease of Use: These are the advantages I've noticed from daily use. The simple button controls make it easy for my husband and in-laws to use. The spacious and versatile interior layout makes loading dishes a breeze. It holds 45 rice bowls, 23 soup bowls, plates, and children's plates. Cooking utensils fit easily as long as you adjust the angle. There's no water splashing or leaking (based on 4 years of use). The interior is intuitively wide, not square, making it easy to load. I found this to be much better than other brands. 7. Installation and maintenance are easy even for a single housewife. The first installation wasn't difficult, and I did it myself when I switched to white. Connecting the hose took just a few minutes. Drainage is also easy. Cleaning is easy thanks to the small internal gaps. The filter only needs to be washed once or twice a week. There haven't been any major issues in 4 years. 8. Design: The BESPOKE is truly beautiful. The pink was beautiful, but the white is even prettier. It's simple yet luxurious, and it doesn't have the "space-hogging" feel typical of countertop models. It keeps the kitchen looking organized, and its sophisticated design adds a significant touch to the interior. It's a design that truly pleases every homemaker. Overall Review: A housewife's verdict after using it for four years: a truly self-made purchase. I'm so satisfied that I'd buy it again. No problems in four years. Excellent cleaning power. Satisfactory drying performance. Good noise reduction. The design is top-notch. It improves the quality of life for housewives. In particular, my in-laws, who tried it, bought it right away and are still using it. I think this is the greatest testament to the actual user satisfaction. I liked the pink version, but the white one I bought this time is even neater and perfectly complements the kitchen atmosphere, making me so happy I bought it again. I confidently recommend it to anyone buying a dishwasher for the first time, those considering a small kitchen, or families with children. Having used it daily for four years, I can say that it's more than worth the money.

분이면 끝•배수도 편함•청소도 내부 틈이 적어서 관리 쉬움•필터는 주 1~2회만 씻어주면 OK4년 동안 특별한 고장 1도 없었습니다.⸻ 8. 디자인 – BESPOKE 진짜 예쁨핑크도 예뻤지만 화이트는 정말 더 예뻐요.심플하면서 고급스럽고, 특히 카운터탑 타입 특유의 ‘공간 차지하는 느낌’이 거의 없습니다.주방이 정돈돼 보이고, 세련된 분위기라 인테리어 Sentence (English): Satisfactory drying performance.
Comments (English): A true homemaker's review of the Samsung Electronics BESPOKE 6-person countertop dishwasher, purchased with her own money after using it for four years. They say only those who have actually used a dishwasher truly understand its convenience. I've been using this product for over four years, and while reorganizing my new home, I switched from the pink color to the white one. Interestingly, my mother-in-law, mother-in-law, and daughter-in-law all bought new ones after seeing me use it, and they're all very happy with it! Now, I'm buying new ones and recommending it to everyone I know. This dishwasher is truly trustworthy. 1. A homemaker's verdict after four years: I can't live without it. When I first bought it, I was skeptical, wondering, "How useful can this small countertop dishwasher be?" But now, I can honestly say it's the best purchase I've made, next to a washing machine vacuum cleaner. It saves me 30-40 minutes of daily hand-washing time, and best of all, it removes grease and grime much more thoroughly than washing dishes by hand. I have a child, so we handle a lot of dishes, and this product has significantly reduced wrist strain. 2. Why I switched from pink to white. The original pink was beautiful and luxurious, typical of BESPOKE, but the heater malfunctioned, so I moved. With my recent kitchen interior renovation, I thought white would be a better match, so I chose it without hesitation. White is much cleaner, makes the kitchen look more spacious, and goes well with any cabinet tone. Just a color change from the new model completely transformed the kitchen. I only changed the dishwasher, and it feels so much cleaner, so I'm 100% satisfied. 3. Cleaning power: This is the most satisfying aspect of my new dishwasher, which has remained constant for four years. Many dishwasher reviews worry that the small size might compromise cleaning power, but my four years of use have proven otherwise. It cleans dried rice, egg wash, and soup stains perfectly. A greasy frying pan is completely clean on high power. It washes children's plates, bottles, and straw cups without any detergent residue. Glass cups retain a clarity that you can never remove by hand. The glass cups, in particular, are incredibly crisp and clear, incomparable to hand washing. The fine oil film that forms when washing dishes by hand is completely gone, and the cups shine like new. 4. Drying Power: Almost perfect, except for the plastic. After four years of use, I've noticed that the drying power is better than I expected. Ceramics are completely fluffy. Frying pans dry well. Glass cups are almost free of water marks. Plastic sometimes has a few water droplets (a common problem with any dishwasher). However, leaving the door slightly open dries quickly, so it's not a major inconvenience. 5. Noise: I can run it at night. I usually run it at night after putting the kids to bed, and I haven't experienced any noise stress in four years. The sound of the water circulating is faint. It doesn't bother me when watching TV. It's also a plus that it's quiet enough to run at night. 6. Ease of Use: These are the advantages I've noticed from daily use. The simple button controls make it easy for my husband and in-laws to use. The spacious and versatile interior layout makes loading dishes a breeze. It holds 45 rice bowls, 23 soup bowls, plates, and children's plates. Cooking utensils fit easily as long as you adjust the angle. There's no water splashing or leaking (based on 4 years of use). The interior is intuitively wide, not square, making it easy to load. I found this to be much better than other brands. 7. Installation and maintenance are easy even for a single housewife. The first installation wasn't difficult, and I did it myself when I switched to white. Connecting the hose took just a few minutes. Drainage is also easy. Cleaning is easy thanks to the small internal gaps. The filter only needs to be washed once or twice a week. There haven't been any major issues in 4 years. 8. Design: The BESPOKE is truly beautiful. The pink was beautiful, but the white is even prettier. It's simple yet luxurious, and it doesn't have the "space-hogging" feel typical of countertop models. It keeps the kitchen looking organized, and its sophisticated design adds a significant touch to the interior. It's a design that truly pleases every homemaker. Overall Review: A housewife's verdict after using it for four years: a truly self-made purchase. I'm so satisfied that I'd buy it again. No problems in four years. Excellent cleaning power. Satisfactory drying performance. Good noise reduction. The design is top-notch. It improves the quality of life for housewives. In particular, my in-laws, who tried it, bought it right away and are still using it. I think this is the greatest testament to the actual user satisfaction. I liked the pink version, but the white one I bought this time is even neater and perfectly complements the kitchen atmosphere, making me so happy I bought it again. I confidently recommend it to anyone buying a dishwasher for the first time, those considering a small kitchen, or families with children. Having used it daily for four years, I can say that it's more than worth the money.

Sentence (English): It improves the quality of life for housewives.
Comments (English): A true homemaker's review of the Samsung Electronics BESPOKE 6-person countertop dishwasher, purchased with her own money after using it for four years. They say only those who have actually used a dishwasher truly understand its convenience. I've been using this product for over four years, and while reorganizing my new home, I switched from the pink color to the white one. Interestingly, my mother-in-law, mother-in-law, and daughter-in-law all bought new ones after seeing me use it, and they're all very happy with it! Now, I'm buying new ones and recommending it to everyone I know. This dishwasher is truly trustworthy. 1. A homemaker's verdict after four years: I can't live without it. When I first bought it, I was skeptical, wondering, "How useful can this small countertop dishwasher be?" But now, I can honestly say it's the best purchase I've made, next to a washing machine vacuum cleaner. It saves me 30-40 minutes of daily hand-washing time, and best of all, it removes grease and grime much more thoroughly than washing dishes by hand. I have a child, so we handle a lot of dishes, and this product has significantly reduced wrist strain. 2. Why I switched from pink to white. The original pink was beautiful and luxurious, typical of BESPOKE, but the heater malfunctioned, so I moved. With my recent kitchen interior renovation, I thought white would be a better match, so I chose it without hesitation. White is much cleaner, makes the kitchen look more spacious, and goes well with any cabinet tone. Just a color change from the new model completely transformed the kitchen. I only changed the dishwasher, and it feels so much cleaner, so I'm 100% satisfied. 3. Cleaning power: This is the most satisfying aspect of my new dishwasher, which has remained constant for four years. Many dishwasher reviews worry that the small size might compromise cleaning power, but my four years of use have proven otherwise. It cleans dried rice, egg wash, and soup stains perfectly. A greasy frying pan is completely clean on high power. It washes children's plates, bottles, and straw cups without any detergent residue. Glass cups retain a clarity that you can never remove by hand. The glass cups, in particular, are incredibly crisp and clear, incomparable to hand washing. The fine oil film that forms when washing dishes by hand is completely gone, and the cups shine like new. 4. Drying Power: Almost perfect, except for the plastic. After four years of use, I've noticed that the drying power is better than I expected. Ceramics are completely fluffy. Frying pans dry well. Glass cups are almost free of water marks. Plastic sometimes has a few water droplets (a common problem with any dishwasher). However, leaving the door slightly open dries quickly, so it's not a major inconvenience. 5. Noise: I can run it at night. I usually run it at night after putting the kids to bed, and I haven't experienced any noise stress in four years. The sound of the water circulating is faint. It doesn't bother me when watching TV. It's also a plus that it's quiet enough to run at night. 6. Ease of Use: These are the advantages I've noticed from daily use. The simple button controls make it easy for my husband and in-laws to use. The spacious and versatile interior layout makes loading dishes a breeze. It holds 45 rice bowls, 23 soup bowls, plates, and children's plates. Cooking utensils fit easily as long as you adjust the angle. There's no water splashing or leaking (based on 4 years of use). The interior is intuitively wide, not square, making it easy to load. I found this to be much better than other brands. 7. Installation and maintenance are easy even for a single housewife. The first installation wasn't difficult, and I did it myself when I switched to white. Connecting the hose took just a few minutes. Drainage is also easy. Cleaning is easy thanks to the small internal gaps. The filter only needs to be washed once or twice a week. There haven't been any major issues in 4 years. 8. Design: The BESPOKE is truly beautiful. The pink was beautiful, but the white is even prettier. It's simple yet luxurious, and it doesn't have the "space-hogging" feel typical of countertop models. It keeps the kitchen looking organized, and its sophisticated design adds a significant touch to the interior. It's a design that truly pleases every homemaker. Overall Review: A housewife's verdict after using it for four years: a truly self-made purchase. I'm so satisfied that I'd buy it again. No problems in four years. Excellent cleaning power. Satisfactory drying performance. Good noise reduction. The design is top-notch. It improves the quality of life for housewives. In particular, my in-laws, who tried it, bought it right away and are still using it. I think this is the greatest testament to the actual user satisfaction. I liked the pink version, but the white one I bought this time is even neater and perfectly complements the kitchen atmosphere, making me so happy I bought it again. I confidently recommend it to anyone buying a dishwasher for the first time, those considering a small kitchen, or families with children. Having used it daily for four years, I can say that it's more than worth the money.

Sentence (English): I liked the pink version, but the white one I bought this time is even neater and perfectly complements the kitchen atmosphere, making me so happy I bought it again.
Comments (English): A true homemaker's review of the Samsung Electronics BESPOKE 6-person countertop dishwasher, purchased with her own money after using it for four years. They say only those who have actually used a dishwasher truly understand its convenience. I've been using this product for over four years, and while reorganizing my new home, I switched from the pink color to the white one. Interestingly, my mother-in-law, mother-in-law, and daughter-in-law all bought new ones after seeing me use it, and they're all very happy with it! Now, I'm buying new ones and recommending it to everyone I know. This dishwasher is truly trustworthy. 1. A homemaker's verdict after four years: I can't live without it. When I first bought it, I was skeptical, wondering, "How useful can this small countertop dishwasher be?" But now, I can honestly say it's the best purchase I've made, next to a washing machine vacuum cleaner. It saves me 30-40 minutes of daily hand-washing time, and best of all, it removes grease and grime much more thoroughly than washing dishes by hand. I have a child, so we handle a lot of dishes, and this product has significantly reduced wrist strain. 2. Why I switched from pink to white. The original pink was beautiful and luxurious, typical of BESPOKE, but the heater malfunctioned, so I moved. With my recent kitchen interior renovation, I thought white would be a better match, so I chose it without hesitation. White is much cleaner, makes the kitchen look more spacious, and goes well with any cabinet tone. Just a color change from the new model completely transformed the kitchen. I only changed the dishwasher, and it feels so much cleaner, so I'm 100% satisfied. 3. Cleaning power: This is the most satisfying aspect of my new dishwasher, which has remained constant for four years. Many dishwasher reviews worry that the small size might compromise cleaning power, but my four years of use have proven otherwise. It cleans dried rice, egg wash, and soup stains perfectly. A greasy frying pan is completely clean on high power. It washes children's plates, bottles, and straw cups without any detergent residue. Glass cups retain a clarity that you can never remove by hand. The glass cups, in particular, are incredibly crisp and clear, incomparable to hand washing. The fine oil film that forms when washing dishes by hand is completely gone, and the cups shine like new. 4. Drying Power: Almost perfect, except for the plastic. After four years of use, I've noticed that the drying power is better than I expected. Ceramics are completely fluffy. Frying pans dry well. Glass cups are almost free of water marks. Plastic sometimes has a few water droplets (a common problem with any dishwasher). However, leaving the door slightly open dries quickly, so it's not a major inconvenience. 5. Noise: I can run it at night. I usually run it at night after putting the kids to bed, and I haven't experienced any noise stress in four years. The sound of the water circulating is faint. It doesn't bother me when watching TV. It's also a plus that it's quiet enough to run at night. 6. Ease of Use: These are the advantages I've noticed from daily use. The simple button controls make it easy for my husband and in-laws to use. The spacious and versatile interior layout makes loading dishes a breeze. It holds 45 rice bowls, 23 soup bowls, plates, and children's plates. Cooking utensils fit easily as long as you adjust the angle. There's no water splashing or leaking (based on 4 years of use). The interior is intuitively wide, not square, making it easy to load. I found this to be much better than other brands. 7. Installation and maintenance are easy even for a single housewife. The first installation wasn't difficult, and I did it myself when I switched to white. Connecting the hose took just a few minutes. Drainage is also easy. Cleaning is easy thanks to the small internal gaps. The filter only needs to be washed once or twice a week. There haven't been any major issues in 4 years. 8. Design: The BESPOKE is truly beautiful. The pink was beautiful, but the white is even prettier. It's simple yet luxurious, and it doesn't have the "space-hogging" feel typical of countertop models. It keeps the kitchen looking organized, and its sophisticated design adds a significant touch to the interior. It's a design that truly pleases every homemaker. Overall Review: A housewife's verdict after using it for four years: a truly self-made purchase. I'm so satisfied that I'd buy it again. No problems in four years. Excellent cleaning power. Satisfactory drying performance. Good noise reduction. The design is top-notch. It improves the quality of life for housewives. In particular, my in-laws, who tried it, bought it right away and are still using it. I think this is the greatest testament to the actual user satisfaction. I liked the pink version, but the white one I bought this time is even neater and perfectly complements the kitchen atmosphere, making me so happy I bought it again. I confidently recommend it to anyone buying a dishwasher for the first time, those considering a small kitchen, or families with children. Having used it daily for four years, I can say that it's more than worth the money.

고급스러웠는데, 히터기능이 고장나서 이사도했고 이번에 주방 인테리어를 바꾸면서 화이트가 더 잘 어울릴 것 같아 고민 없이 화이트로 선택했어요.•화이트는 훨씬 더 깔끔하고•주방이 넓어 보이고•어떤 톤의 상부장/하부장에도 잘 어울리고새 제품이랑 색감만 바뀌었을 뿐인데 주방 분위기가 확 달라졌어요.식기세척기 하나만 바꿨는데 깔끔함이 훨씬 살아나는 느낌이라 만족도 100%.️ 3. 세척력 – 4년 동안 변함없이 가장 만족하는 부분여러 식기세척기 후기를 보면 “작아서 세척력이 약하지 않을까?” 이런 걱정을 하는데, 제가 4년을 써 본 결과는 확실합니다.✔ 말라붙은 밥풀, 계란물, 국물 자국 → 깔끔하게 제거됨✔ 기름기 많은 프라이팬 → 강력으로 돌리면 정말 깨끗✔ 아이 식판, 젖병, 빨대컵 → 세제 잔여감 없이 세척됨✔ 유리컵은 손으로 절대 못 내는 투명도가 살아남특히 유리컵의 뽀득함 + 맑은 투명함은 손 설거지와 비교가 안 돼요.손 설거지할 때 생기는 미세 기름막 같은 게 아예 없어지고, 컵이 완전 새 컵처럼 반짝합니다.⸻ 4. 건조력 – 플라스틱만 아니면 거의 완벽함4년 동안 사용하면서 느낀 건 건조력이 생각보다 좋다는 점이에요.•도자기류 → 완전히 뽀송•프라이팬 → 잘 건조됨•유리컵 → 물자국 거의 없음•플라스틱 → 약간 물방울 남을 때 있음 (어느 식기세척기도 공통)하지만 문 열어 조금 열어두면 금방 마르기 때문에 크게 불편하진 않았어요.⸻ 5. 소음 – 밤에도 돌릴 수 있는 수준저는 주로 아이들 재운 뒤 밤에 돌리는 편인데, 4년 동안 소음으로 스트레스를 받은 적이 없어요.•물 도는 소리가 약하게 들리는 정도•TV 볼 때도 신경 안 쓰임•아파트에서도 전혀 문제 없음밤 돌리기 부담 없는 소음 수준이라 이것도 장점.⸻ 6. 사용 편의성 – 주부가 매일 쓰면서 느낀 장점들✔ 버튼 조작이 단순해서 남편, 시부모님도 쉽게 사용✔ 내부 배치가 넓고 다양해서 식기 넣기 편함✔ 밥그릇 45개, 국그릇 23개, 접시, 아이식판 다 들어감✔ 조리도구도 각도만 맞추면 수월하게 들어감✔ 외부 물 튀는 일 없고 물 새는 일 전혀 없음 (4년 사용 기준)특히 내부가 ㄹ자 구조가 아니라 직관적으로 넓게 뻗은 구조라서 넣기가 쉬워요.이 부분은 다른 브랜드보다 훨씬 좋다고 느꼈습니다.⸻ 7. 설치, 관리 – 주부 혼자서도 가능처음 설치할 때도 어렵지 않았고, 이번에 화이트로 바꿀 때도 제가 혼자 설치했어요.•호스 연결 → 몇 분이면 끝•배수도 편함•청소도 내부 틈이 적어서 관리 쉬움•필터는 주 1~2회만 씻어주면 OK4년 동안 특별한 고장 1도 없었습니다.⸻ 8. 디자인 – BESPOKE 진짜 예쁨핑크도 예뻤지만 화이트는 정말 더 예뻐요.심플하면서 고급스럽고, 특히 카운터탑 타입 특유의 ‘공간 차지하는 느낌’이 거의 없습니다.주방이 정돈돼 보이고, 세련된 분위기라 인테리어 효과도 커요.주부의 눈을 만족시키는 디자인이라는 게 가장 정확해요.⸻ 총평: 4년 써본 주부의 진짜 내돈내산 결론✔ 다시 사라면 또 살 만큼 만족도 높음✔ 4년 동안 고장 없음✔ 세척력 → 뛰어남✔ 건조력 → 만족✔ 소음 → 양호✔ 디자인 → 최고✔ 주부 삶의 질이 올라감특히“이 제품 써본 시댁 아가씨도 바로 사서 지금도 잘 쓰고 있다”는 부분이 실사용자 만족도를 말해주는 가장 큰 증거라고 생각해요.핑크 버전도 좋았지만, 이번에 산 화이트는 더 깔끔하고 주방 분위기를 완전히 살려줘서 재구매하길 너무 잘했다는 생각이 듭니다.식세기 처음 사는 분, 작은 주방이라 고민하는 분, 아이 있는 집 모두에게 자신 있게 추천합니다.4년 동안 매일같이 사용해 본 입장에서 돈값 이상 하는 제품이에요.

Sentence (English): There is a caveat here, one that needs explanation.
Comments (English): [ Electronic not electric ] || ---------------- || There is a caveat here, one that needs explanation. About six weeks after the initial installation, our old dishwasher that had worked up until that time(but was showing signs of age), the dishwasher started acting strangely. Lights on the control panel came on automatically, cycled through various configurations and I couldn't make them stop and I couldn't turn the machine off. I unplugged it and contacted Home Depot(we had ordered it online through Home Depot website). The employees there were most helpful and contacted GE. Subsequently, a service technician was dispatched(about a week later during which time we were unable to use the dishwasher). He diagnosed the problem and stated the control panel was malfunctioning. A part need to be ordered and I was informed that such a part might be hard to find. About ten days later a return appointment was scheduled for a few days later. The service fellow brought a whole new door to the machine, installed it and was satisfied with the results. About six weeks later the machine started doing the same thing again, lights flashing on and off and not responding to turning off. I unplugged it. Again GE sent out a service tech. About a week after that(again not being able to use the dishwasher in the meantime) the service tech appt was scheduled and about three days later the same tech showed up with a new control panel. He installed it, The machine started doing the same routine of flashing lights, etc. He reported this to GE and it was agreed to replace the machine. About a week later an appt was made to replace the machine. Two fellows brought a new machine, installed it and removed the old one. This one worked for about three days as it should. Then the lights began flashing and cycling and I unplugged it. The service tech came out after a brief period of days. When he arrived I asked him if it was possible that a voltage surge might have caused the problems. He suggested we check the voltage to the machine. Upon doing so he reported that on one side of the source the voltage was where it should be, but on the other side the voltage was low. Remember that we had been using a dishwasher that worked fine until we upgraded. The old dishwasher was not electronic. Apparently, the GE dishwasher is electronic and was affected by the voltage issue. An electrician was called out within a day and he found that the ground wire had not been connected originally to the circuit. After connecting a ground wire the machine has worked fine(but it hasn't been six weeks yet(remember that was the cycle of time it took for the first replacement to start malfunctioning).The "moral" of the story is that this new, upgraded electronic appliance required electric in a form that the old, non-electronic dishwasher it replaced did not need. I hope the service tech learned a lesson. And I hope that the folks at GE also learned something from this experience

Sentence (English): Replaced a 1 yr old LG that started leaking with this dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Dishwasher is awesome ] || ---------------- || Replaced a 1 yr old LG that started leaking with this dishwasher. The interior space of the kitchenaid dishwasher is very very nice. The layout was well thought out and all size dishes fit very well. Basically there are no areas on the racks that become dead or unused space like the LG had. The top most rack is the best, because we can also fit small dishes plus cooking utensils up there. The top rack has the 360 jet system, in general I can say that the dishes regardless of what rack they are on get cleaned very well. That has not been the case with other dishwashers in the past. I am knocking off one star due to the dishwasher not being the most quiet. It is 44db so coming from a 40dB it was noticeable. The fact it cleans better and has more jets is likely why the higher noise rating. I added sound deadning material to the floor under the dishwasher to make it quieter and it has worked well, probably just as quiet as our old dishwasher now. I also noticed that the components on the dishwasher are very simple. Initially I took this as being cheap, but compared to the densely packaged and over engineered LG, this will be a good thing if it ever needs to be serviced in the future as it will make repairs easy and cheap when it comes out of warranty. That was the downfall of our old dishwasher, repair costs exceeded the cost of the dishwasher. I did need to contact support for an issue and I was pleasantly surprised to speak to a human from Georgia. That alone sold me, we get local customer support on our appliance's! The support person was super knowledgeable of the kitchenaid products and even answered my question of why the dishwasher comes new with small amounts of moisture on the lines (they test each and every one of them apparently). They straightened my issue right away too!

Sentence (English): We've had this GE dishwasher installed for about two months.
Comments (English): [ Cleans well but third rack feels flimsy ] || ---------------- || We've had this GE dishwasher installed for about two months. The appliance arrived via freight delivery and installation was handled by professionals who connected the water line, drain, and electrical. The unit fits standard 24-inch openings. The Dry Boost technology does work well - plastics and containers come out noticeably drier compared to our previous dishwasher. Items that used to have water pooling are now mostly dry. The third rack provides extra loading space for utensils, small bowls, and lids. However, the rack feels lightweight and somewhat flimsy. The plastic construction flexes when loading heavier items and I'm careful not to overload it. The four bottle wash jets are positioned in the back of the lower rack. They work well for tall water bottles and narrow vases, directing water upward into the openings. The adjustable upper rack has a lever system that raises or lowers the entire rack to accommodate taller items below. This flexibility is useful when loading large platters or pots. The steam and sanitize cycle runs at high temperature and takes longer but provides thorough cleaning. The various wash cycles handle different load types - heavy, normal, light, and the one-hour quick cycle. The one-hour cycle is convenient for lightly soiled dishes when we need clean plates quickly. For heavily soiled pots and pans, the longer cycles provide better results. The flood protection feature provides reassurance though we haven't had any overflow situations to test it. The noise level during operation is moderate - noticeable but not disruptive to conversation in adjacent rooms. After two months of daily use, the dishwasher is performing consistently with clean dishes every cycle. Overall this is a capable dishwasher with useful features and good cleaning performance.

Sentence (English): My previous five-year-old SK dishwasher had a broken button, so I decided to replace it with a Samsung Bespoke dishwasher.
Comments (English): My previous five-year-old SK dishwasher had a broken button, so I decided to replace it with a Samsung Bespoke dishwasher. The installers visited me in person. The first installer checked if the dishwasher could be installed and cut the mop base (at no cost). The second installer, two people, completed the installation in just 30-40 minutes. They meticulously adjusted everything from arranging the pipes to leveling the unit, and kindly explained each step of the installation. They even explained the differences between the different wash cycles, the amount of detergent to use, and even tips for using rinse aid, so I was able to use it right away. The cleaning power exceeded my expectations. Pots, glasses, bowls, and even chopsticks were all cleaned thoroughly, with virtually no water stains. Even greasy pots can be easily cleaned in AI mode, which automatically determines the level of dirt and adjusts the wash time, eliminating the need to choose a cycle each time. It's also quieter than I expected, so I can use it at night without any issues. The interior space is also well utilized. The tray height is adjustable, allowing me to easily fit large pots and pans. Compared to the previous model, this dishwasher has more space. Putting the dishwasher away right after a meal keeps the dishes from piling up, keeping the kitchen always tidy. I chose Essential White, which has a subtle texture and a non-glossy finish that blends well with the kitchen interior. Its sleek, built-in design makes it easy to spot for first-time users. The interior lighting is also soft and luxurious when the door is opened. One thing I found disappointing while using it: the remaining time isn't immediately visible on the front panel, requiring a phone check. It would have been better if it had been displayed on the device itself, especially when I need to check the remaining time while doing chores. There were a few instances of a little foam remaining after the first few cycles. Reducing the amount of detergent as instructed in the manual immediately resolved the issue. This LG dishwasher has been a nightmare from day one and finally gave up the ghost at 2.5 years old.• Noise: Absolutely deafening. The motor/howling pump sounds like a jet engine taking off in the kitchen. Normal conversation is impossible while it's running.• Cleaning performance: Mediocre at best. My dog could do a better job licking the plates clean. Baked-on food laughs at this thing.• Drying: What drying? Even with “Extra Dry” and a rinse-aid pod, everything comes out soaking wet. The app just tells you “there's an error” and suggests you call service.• Reliability & warranty: Pump failed at 2.5 years. LG's standard warranty is a pathetic 1 year; the pump itself is supposedly covered for 5 years but good luck—parts are backordered for months and labor isn't covered. Extended warranties (SquareTrade, etc.) deny claims left and right for these units. Repair quote was almost the price of a new dishwasher.I'm now stuck replacing a $900+ appliance that lasted less time than a cheap builder-grade unit from 20 years ago. Do yourself a favor and buy literally any other brand—Miele, Bosch, even a mid-range GE or Whirlpool. Anything but LG dishwashers. I wouldn't inflict this thing on anyone, not even for free.Strongly recommend you avoid this model (and honestly most current LG products). Total lemons.
